1306.0895.title: Sinkhorn Distances: Lightspeed Computation of Optimal Transportation Distances
1306.0895.tldr_zh: 给 OT 加熵约束/熵罚，最优耦合为 diag(u)e^{-λM}diag(v)，Sinkhorn–Knopp 缩放求解，比 EMD 快数个量级且 MNIST 分类更好
1306.0895.tldr_en: Entropic regularization turns OT into a strictly convex problem solved by Sinkhorn-Knopp matrix scaling, orders of magnitude faster than EMD solvers, with better MNIST accuracy.

1508.05216.title: Unbalanced Optimal Transport: Dynamic and Kantorovich Formulation
1508.05216.tldr_zh: 建立非平衡 OT 的动态与静态半耦合两种等价形式，WFR 度量属于此类
1508.05216.tldr_en: Establishes equivalence between dynamic and static semi-coupling formulations of unbalanced OT; WFR metric is a special case

1603.05579.title: Convergence of a Newton algorithm for semi-discrete optimal transport
1603.05579.tldr_zh: 半离散 OT 阻尼 Newton 法全局线性、局部 1+α 阶收敛，条件为 MTW 型代价 + 源密度加权 Poincaré–Wirtinger
1603.05579.tldr_en: Damped Newton for semi-discrete OT converges globally linearly and locally at rate 1+alpha under Loeper/MTW cost condition and a weighted Poincare-Wirtinger inequality on the source.

1706.00292.title: Learning Generative Models with Sinkhorn Divergences
1706.00292.tldr_zh: 把 L 步 Sinkhorn 迭代当可自动微分的损失层，用 minibatch Sinkhorn loss 训练生成器；证 ε→0 得 OT、ε→∞ 得 MMD
1706.00292.tldr_en: Trains generators by backpropagating through L Sinkhorn iterations on minibatches; proves the Sinkhorn loss interpolates between OT (eps to 0) and MMD (eps to infinity).

1709.06464.title: Comparison of transport map generated by heat flow interpolation and the optimal transport Brenier map
1709.06464.tldr_zh: Kim-Milman热流插值传输映射一般≠Brenier映射：高斯(drift -Ax)显式反例，标准高斯数值反例
1709.06464.tldr_en: Kim-Milman heat-flow transport map generally differs from the Brenier map: explicit Gaussian counterexample with drift -Ax, numerical one for standard Gaussian.

1803.00567.title: Computational Optimal Transport
1803.00567.tldr_zh: 计算 OT 标准教材，10 章覆盖离散 OT、对偶、Sinkhorn、半离散、动态形式、barycenter，从零到能跑代码
1803.00567.tldr_en: Standard computational-OT textbook: discrete OT, duality, Sinkhorn, semi-discrete, Benamou-Brenier dynamics, barycenters, with three-layer exposition and code.

1803.05573.title: Improving GANs Using Optimal Transport
1803.05573.tldr_zh: minibatch energy distance：primal Sinkhorn 距离嵌入对抗特征空间，梯度无偏、大 batch 稳定
1803.05573.tldr_en: Minibatch energy distance combines primal Sinkhorn OT with adversarial features for unbiased GAN gradients

1805.09114.title: Optimal Transport for structured data with application on graphs
1805.09114.tldr_zh: 提出 FGW 距离，凸组合特征 Wasserstein 与结构 GW，用于图分类与 barycenter 聚类
1805.09114.tldr_en: Proposes Fused Gromov-Wasserstein distance combining feature Wasserstein and structural GW for graph classification and barycenter clustering

1809.00013.title: Gromov-Wasserstein Alignment of Word Embedding Spaces
1809.00013.tldr_zh: 用 Gromov-Wasserstein 距离无监督对齐跨语言词嵌入，单步优化，性能与 SOTA 相当
1809.00013.tldr_en: Unsupervised cross-lingual word embedding alignment via Gromov-Wasserstein distance, single-step, comparable to SOTA

1810.01118.title: Sinkhorn AutoEncoders
1810.01118.tldr_zh: 在 WAE 框架内用 Sinkhorn 散度做 latent 匹配，证明 W_p 惩罚给出原目标上界，γ 是解码器 Lipschitz 常数
1810.01118.tldr_en: Uses Sinkhorn divergence for latent matching in WAE; proves W_p penalty upper-bounds the OT objective with γ as decoder Lipschitz constant

1810.08278.title: Interpolating between Optimal Transport and MMD using Sinkhorn Divergences
1810.08278.tldr_zh: 证明 debiased Sinkhorn divergence S_ε 对任意 ε>0 正定、凸、度量化弱收敛（ε→0 得 OT，ε→∞ 得 MMD），并给出百万点 GPU 实现
1810.08278.tldr_en: Proves the debiased Sinkhorn divergence is positive definite, convex and metrizes weak convergence for every epsilon, with a million-sample GPU implementation.

1812.05189.title: Massively scalable Sinkhorn distances via the Nyström method
1812.05189.tldr_zh: Nyström 低秩核近似 + Sinkhorn 缩放，近线性时间/内存计算 Sinkhorn 距离，有精度保证
1812.05189.tldr_en: Nyström low-rank kernel approximation plus Sinkhorn scaling gives near-linear time/memory Sinkhorn distances with provable accuracy

1904.12785.title: Style Transfer by Relaxed Optimal Transport and Self-Similarity
1904.12785.tldr_zh: 用 relaxed EMD 定义风格损失、自相似性定义内容损失，用户研究显示风格化质量优于对比方法
1904.12785.tldr_en: Style loss via relaxed EMD and content loss via self-similarity; user study shows better stylization quality than baselines

1905.05828.title: Minimax estimation of smooth optimal transport maps
1905.05828.tldr_zh: α-光滑强凸势 Brenier map 的 minimax 率 n^{-2α/(2α-2+d)}∨n^{-1}（log 内），半对偶+截断小波估计器达到；首个一般维度结果
1905.05828.tldr_en: First general-dimension minimax rate n^{-2α/(2α-2+d)} for smooth Brenier maps, attained by a wavelet-restricted empirical semi-dual estimator via a new semi-dual stability bound.

1905.11882.title: Statistical bounds for entropic optimal transport: sample complexity and the central limit theorem
1905.11882.tldr_zh: EOT 经验估计对 subgaussian 分布达 O(1/√n)，无指数因子，并证 CLT
1905.11882.tldr_en: EOT empirical cost converges at O(1/sqrt(n)) for subgaussian measures, with CLT

1909.12116.title: Optimal Transport driven CycleGAN for Unsupervised Learning in Inverse Problems
1909.12116.tldr_zh: 从 Kantorovich 对偶推导 OT-cycleGAN，前向算子已知时砍掉一半生成器，在加速 MRI、SMLM、低剂量 CT 验证
1909.12116.tldr_en: Derives OT-cycleGAN from Kantorovich duality; known forward operator halves the architecture; validated on accelerated MRI, SMLM, low-dose CT

1910.04091.title: Learning with minibatch Wasserstein: asymptotic and gradient properties
1910.04091.tldr_zh: minibatch OT 是隐式正则化：估计与梯度无偏、集中界与维度无关，但失去距离性质、平均 plan 非最优。
1910.04091.tldr_en: Minibatch OT losses are unbiased with dimension-free concentration and unbiased gradients, but lose the metric property and yield non-optimal averaged plans.

1910.05653.title: Model Fusion via Optimal Transport
1910.05653.tldr_zh: 逐层用最优传输对齐神经元再平均权重，实现无需训练数据的一次性神经网络融合
1910.05653.tldr_en: Layer-wise OT alignment of neurons before weight averaging enables one-shot, data-free neural network fusion

2003.00855.title: Optimal transport: discretization and algorithms
2003.00855.tldr_zh: 以 Kantorovich 对偶为主线自包含分析 auction、Sinkhorn、半离散 Oliker–Prussner/阻尼 Newton 的讲义，半离散 OT 最佳入口
2003.00855.tldr_en: Handbook chapter giving self-contained convergence analyses of auction, Sinkhorn-Knopp and semi-discrete (Laguerre-cell, damped Newton) algorithms via Kantorovich duality.

2005.10963.title: Stochastic Control Liaisons: Richard Sinkhorn Meets Gaspard Monge on a Schrödinger Bridge
2005.10963.tldr_zh: 随机控制视角的 SB/OMT 历史-技术综述：Schrödinger 系统、Problem 4.3 控制形式、广义退化扩散桥、Sinkhorn=离散 Schrödinger 系统
2005.10963.tldr_en: SIAM Review survey unifying Sinkhorn/IPF, Fortet iterations, Schrödinger systems and Benamou-Brenier OT through stochastic control; generalized bridges with degenerate diffusion.

2006.07229.title: A Sliced Wasserstein Loss for Neural Texture Synthesis
2006.07229.tldr_zh: 用 Sliced Wasserstein Distance 替代 Gram 矩阵作纹理损失，捕获完整特征分布，纹理合成质量优于 Gram。
2006.07229.tldr_en: Replaces Gram-matrix loss with Sliced Wasserstein Distance for neural texture synthesis, capturing full feature distributions.

2006.08172.title: Faster Wasserstein Distance Estimation with the Sinkhorn Divergence
2006.08172.tldr_zh: 证明 debiased Sinkhorn divergence 估计平方 W₂ 距离在更大 ε 下仍达近最优误差，计算-统计两头受益
2006.08172.tldr_en: Debiased Sinkhorn divergence estimates squared W2 with larger ε at near-optimal error, improving both computation and statistics

2010.02502.title: Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models
2010.02502.tldr_zh: 把 DDPM 采样确定化为非马尔可夫隐式过程，10–50 步生成高质量样本，并给出确定性 encode–decode 映射
2010.02502.tldr_en: Deterministic non-Markovian sampling for DDPMs, achieving 10-50x speedup with an ODE-based encode-decode mapping

2102.05912.title: On Transportation of Mini-batches: A Hierarchical Approach
2102.05912.tldr_zh: BoMb-OT 在 minibatch 之间再解一层 k×k OT 加权聚合，逼近一个真度量；m-OT 是其熵正则 λ→∞ 极限。
2102.05912.tldr_en: Batch-of-Mini-batches OT couples mini-batches with a second-level k x k OT, approximating a true metric; m-OT is its infinite-entropy limit.

2103.04737.title: Low-Rank Sinkhorn Factorization
2103.04737.tldr_zh: 直接约束耦合非负秩，任意 cost 通用，低秩 cost 下线性时间，证明非渐近平稳收敛
2103.04737.tldr_en: Directly constrains coupling nonnegative rank, arbitrary costs, linear time under low-rank cost, non-asymptotic stationary convergence

2106.00736.title: Large-Scale Wasserstein Gradient Flows
2106.00736.tldr_zh: Brenier 定理把 JKO 步改写为凸势优化，ICNN 参数化 + SGD 求解，免网格免粒子且可采样算密度
2106.00736.tldr_en: Rewrites each JKO step via Brenier as optimization over convex potentials parametrized by ICNNs and trained with SGD; grid-free, particle-free, with sampling and density evaluation.

2106.01128.title: Linear-Time Gromov Wasserstein Distances using Low Rank Couplings and Costs
2106.01128.tldr_zh: 低秩耦合+低秩代价分解把GW从O(n³)降到O(n²)乃至O(n)，单细胞对齐快几个数量级
2106.01128.tldr_en: Low-rank couplings and costs reduce GW from O(n³) to O(n²) or O(n), orders of magnitude faster on single-cell alignment

2106.01954.title: Do Neural Optimal Transport Solvers Work? A Continuous Wasserstein-2 Benchmark
2106.01954.tldr_zh: ICNN 梯度构造有解析真值的连续 W2 基准（至 CelebA64），评测 7 类求解器：多数 map 不准，map 准不等于生成好
2106.01954.tldr_en: ICNN-gradient benchmark pairs with analytic W2 maps up to CelebA64; most neural OT solvers recover maps poorly, and OT accuracy does not predict generative quality.

2106.01963.title: A Survey on Optimal Transport for Machine Learning: Theory and Applications
2106.01963.tldr_zh: 面向 ML 读者的 OT 入门综述，覆盖历史、对偶/熵正则数学预备与五类应用，无新理论或新实验。
2106.01963.tldr_en: An application-focused OT survey for ML readers covering history, duality/entropic regularization math prerequisites, and five application areas; no new theory or experiments.

2106.03812.title: Neural Monge Map estimation and its applications
2106.03812.tldr_zh: Monge 问题 Lagrange 松弛成 max-min，一般 cost、跨维度，duality gap 给后验误差界；unpaired 文生图与补全
2106.03812.tldr_en: Lagrangian max-min for the Monge problem with general costs and unequal dimensions, a duality-gap posterior error bound, applied to unpaired text-to-image and inpainting.

2106.06345.title: Proximal Optimal Transport Modeling of Population Dynamics
2106.06345.tldr_zh: JKOnet：把 ICNN 求解的 JKO 步当可微模块，双层优化从时序快照反学 potential 能量，单细胞上优于 forward 法
2106.06345.tldr_en: JKOnet treats ICNN-solved JKO steps as differentiable layers and learns the driving potential energy from population snapshots via bilevel optimization with Sinkhorn losses.

2106.10482.title: Unbalanced Feature Transport for Exemplar-based Image Translation
2106.10482.tldr_zh: 用不平衡 OT 对齐条件输入与 exemplar 特征，解决跨域分布偏差下的 many-to-one 匹配
2106.10482.tldr_en: Unbalanced OT aligns conditional input and exemplar features to fix many-to-one matching under distribution shift

2107.03006.title: Structured Denoising Diffusion Models in Discrete State-Spaces
2107.03006.tldr_zh: D3PM 用结构化转移矩阵统一离散扩散，absorbing 在文本、离散化高斯在图像上最优
2107.03006.tldr_en: D3PM generalizes discrete diffusion via structured transition matrices; absorbing best for text, discretized Gaussian best for images

2107.12364.title: Plugin Estimation of Smooth Optimal Transport Maps
2107.12364.tldr_zh: 可计算的 plug-in 估计器（经验耦合+平滑/密度估计）达到 OT map 的 minimax 率，并给出 W2² 的 CLT
2107.12364.tldr_en: Computable plug-in estimators achieve minimax rates for smooth OT maps, with CLT for squared Wasserstein distance

2109.12004.title: Entropic estimation of optimal transport maps
2109.12004.tldr_zh: 熵耦合的 barycentric projection = Id − ∇f_ε（熵版 Brenier），Sinkhorn 即可算，L² 风险率 n^{-(ᾱ+1)/(2(d+ᾱ+1))} log n
2109.12004.tldr_en: The barycentric projection of the entropic plan equals Id minus the gradient of the entropic potential; computable by Sinkhorn with finite-sample L2 rates.

2110.02999.title: Generative Modeling with Optimal Transport Maps
2110.02999.tldr_zh: 普通 CNN 在 ambient 图像空间解 W2 min-max 学 OT map 当生成器（OTM），支持不等维嵌入 cost，duality-gap 界 FID
2110.02999.tldr_en: OTM learns the W2 optimal transport map directly in ambient image space with plain CNNs via min-max, handles unequal dimensions, and bounds FID by duality gaps.

2110.11773.title: Sinkformers: Transformers with Doubly Stochastic Attention
2110.11773.tldr_zh: 用 Sinkhorn 双随机归一化替换 softmax attention，attention 可解释为 Wasserstein 梯度流，实验精度小幅提升
2110.11773.tldr_en: Replace softmax attention with Sinkhorn doubly stochastic normalization; attention becomes a Wasserstein gradient flow with modest accuracy gains

2111.11521.title: The Brownian transport map
2111.11521.tldr_zh: 用 Föllmer 过程构造 Wiener 测度到目标测度的传输映射，在 OT 映射收缩性开放情形证明几乎必然收缩，导出新泛函不等式与 Stein kernel 结果
2111.11521.tldr_en: Constructs a transport map via the Föllmer process from Wiener measure to Euclidean target measures, proving almost-sure contraction where OT map contraction is open, yielding new functional inequalities and Stein kernels

2112.02424.title: Variational Wasserstein gradient flow
2112.02424.tldr_zh: 用 f-divergence 变分对偶式替代显式密度项，JKO 步变为 (T,h) min-max，训练时间不随维数增长
2112.02424.tldr_en: Replaces density-dependent functionals in JKO steps by the f-divergence variational form, yielding a primal-dual min-max per step whose cost is dimension-independent.

2201.12220.title: Neural Optimal Transport
2201.12220.tldr_zh: weak OT 对偶化为 sup_f inf_T 鞍点，带噪声输入的 T(x,z) 学随机 plan；NN 为 plan 万能逼近器；unpaired 翻译 FID 优于 CycleGAN 系
2201.12220.tldr_en: Weak-OT dual becomes a sup_f inf_T saddle problem; a noise-conditioned network T(x,z) learns stochastic plans; NNs universally approximate plans; strong unpaired I2I FID.

2202.02763.title: Riemannian Score-Based Generative Modelling
2202.02763.tldr_zh: 把 SGM 前向/反向 SDE 推广到黎曼流形，用测地随机游走采样，在球面、环面、SO(3) 上验证
2202.02763.tldr_en: Extends score-based generative models to Riemannian manifolds via geodesic random walks and heat kernel approximations

2202.07477.title: Understanding DDPM Latent Codes Through Optimal Transport
2202.07477.tldr_zh: 猜想DDPM PF-ODE encoder=到N(0,I)的Monge OT映射；多元高斯证明，TT求解器合成分布代价误差~1e-15
2202.07477.tldr_en: Conjectures the DDPM PF-ODE encoder equals the Monge OT map to N(0,I); proven for Gaussians, transport-cost error ~1e-15 on synthetic densities via tensor-train FP solver.

2202.08919.title: Debiaser Beware: Pitfalls of Centering Regularized Transport Maps
2202.08919.tldr_zh: Sinkhorn map T^D_ε=T_ε+∇α_ε 在 ε→0 时不比 entropic map 差（Gaussian 下 O(ε⁴) vs O(ε²)），但 ε 大或样本少时可被任意倍劣化
2202.08919.tldr_en: Debiased Sinkhorn map matches the entropic map as epsilon to 0 (O(eps^4) vs O(eps^2) for Gaussians) but can be arbitrarily worse for large epsilon or small samples.

2203.08382.title: Dual Diffusion Implicit Bridges for Image-to-Image Translation
2203.08382.tldr_zh: 两域独立扩散经PF-ODE latent拼接翻译，等价两段SB串联
2203.08382.tldr_en: Chains two independently trained diffusion PF-ODEs through a shared latent for training-free translation, interpreted as two concatenated Schrödinger bridges.

2204.08472.title: Simultaneous Multiple-Prompt Guided Generation Using Differentiable Optimal Transport
2204.08472.tldr_zh: 用可微 Sinkhorn OT 替换多 prompt 引导的均值损失，缓解生成图像向 prompt 均值塌缩
2204.08472.tldr_en: Replaces mean-distance loss in multi-prompt VQGAN-CLIP guidance with differentiable Sinkhorn OT to reduce mode collapse

2204.13902.title: Fast Sampling of Diffusion Models with Exponential Integrator
2204.13902.tldr_zh: DEIS 用指数积分器+多项式外推解扩散 ODE，10 NFE 在 CIFAR10 达 4.17 FID
2204.13902.tldr_en: DEIS applies exponential integrator with polynomial extrapolation to diffusion ODEs, reaching 4.17 FID at 10 NFE on CIFAR10

2205.06688.title: A Unified Framework for Implicit Sinkhorn Differentiation
2205.06688.tldr_zh: 用隐式函数定理统一 Sinkhorn 层梯度，同时可微 cost 与边缘，内存 O(n²) 且梯度误差有界
2205.06688.tldr_en: Unified implicit differentiation for Sinkhorn layers, jointly differentiating cost and marginals with O(n²) memory and bounded gradient error

2205.07680.title: BBDM: Image-to-image Translation with Brownian Bridge Diffusion Models
2205.07680.tldr_zh: latent Brownian桥做I2I、无条件输入；FID略优LDM
2205.07680.tldr_en: Models I2I as a latent Brownian bridge without conditioning inputs; CelebAMask-HQ FID 21.35 vs LDM 22.82.

2205.15269.title: Kernel Neural Optimal Transport
2205.15269.tldr_zh: 证明 NOT 在 gamma-weak 二次 cost 下鞍点含大量 fake solution，改用特征核 weak cost 后所有鞍点都是 OT plan；翻译 FID 与稳定性改善
2205.15269.tldr_en: NOT with the gamma-weak quadratic cost admits many fake saddle points; characteristic-kernel weak costs make every optimal saddle point a true OT plan and improve I2I FID and stability.

2205.15403.title: Neural Optimal Transport with General Cost Functionals
2205.15403.tldr_zh: NOT 的 max-min 推广到任意凸 lsc 泛函 F(pi)，无位势凸性假设的 duality-gap 界；class-guided 泛函用每类 10 标签实现保类翻译
2205.15403.tldr_en: Generalizes the NOT saddle-point solver to arbitrary convex lsc cost functionals F(pi), proves a duality-gap bound without potential convexity, and builds class- and pair-guided functionals.

2205.15902.title: Variational inference via Wasserstein gradient flows
2205.15902.tldr_zh: Gaussian VI 即 KL 在 Bures-Wasserstein 子流形上的梯度流（Särkkä ODE），强 log-concave 下有 e^{-2αt} 与 SGD 非渐近界
2205.15902.tldr_en: Gaussian VI is the KL gradient flow on the Bures-Wasserstein manifold (Särkkä's ODE); strongly log-concave targets give exponential rates and a non-asymptotic SGD bound; mixtures become interacting Gaussian particles.

2206.00364.title: Elucidating the Design Space of Diffusion-Based Generative Models
2206.00364.tldr_zh: 拆解扩散设计空间：σ(t)=t、Heun、ρ=7 调度、预条件；35 NFE CIFAR-10 FID 1.97
2206.00364.tldr_en: Separates diffusion design choices (sigma(t)=t, Heun, rho=7 schedule, preconditioning); FID 1.97 on CIFAR-10 at 35 NFE.

2206.00927.title: DPM-Solver: A Fast ODE Solver for Diffusion Probabilistic Model Sampling in Around 10 Steps
2206.00927.tldr_zh: 半线性结构：线性项解析、log-SNR 域泰勒展开网络项，1–3 阶指数积分器；10 NFE FID 4.70
2206.00927.tldr_en: Exploits semi-linear diffusion ODE: analytic linear part, Taylor expansion in log-SNR; order-1/2/3 exponential integrators reach FID 4.70 at 10 NFE.

2207.03024.title: Riemannian Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge
2207.03024.tldr_zh: 把 DSB/IPF 推广到紧黎曼流形，用流形时间反演+score matching 做球面数据生成与插值
2207.03024.tldr_en: Extends DSB/IPF to compact Riemannian manifolds for generation and interpolation on spherical data

2209.03003.title: Flow Straight and Fast: Learning to Generate and Transfer Data with Rectified Flow
2209.03003.tldr_zh: 提出 rectified flow 与 reflow：保边缘 ODE、凸代价单调不增、O(1/K) 拉直，CIFAR-10 一步 FID 4.85
2209.03003.tldr_en: Rectified flow regresses linear-interpolation velocities; reflow provably straightens paths and lowers convex transport costs; one-step CIFAR-10 FID 4.85 after distillation.

2209.07007.title: Gromov-Wasserstein Autoencoders
2209.07007.tldr_zh: 用 GW 度量直接匹配 latent 与 data 距离结构，替换 ELBO，解耦与聚类上不改目标即优于 VAE 系基线
2209.07007.tldr_en: Replaces ELBO with GW metric to match latent and data distance structures, outperforming VAE baselines on disentanglement and clustering

2209.11215.title: Sampling is as easy as learning the score: theory for diffusion models with minimal data assumptions
2209.11215.tldr_zh: L² score+Lipschitz score+二阶矩下 DDPM 以 Θ̃(L²d/ε²) 步 TV-ε 逼近任意非 log-concave 分布；确立 Girsanov 范式
2209.11215.tldr_en: With L2-accurate scores, DDPM samples any non-log-concave distribution in Θ̃(L²d/ε²) steps (TV); establishes the Girsanov path-KL analysis paradigm.

2209.14577.title: Rectified Flow: A Marginal Preserving Approach to Optimal Transport
2209.14577.tldr_zh: 速度场限制为 ∇c*(∇f) 的 c-rectified flow，声称不动点即 c-最优耦合；纯理论无实验
2209.14577.tldr_en: c-rectified flow constrains velocity to gradient form; author claims fixed points are c-optimal couplings via HJ equation. Pure theory, later shown to need stronger assumptions.

2209.15571.title: Building Normalizing Flows with Stochastic Interpolants
2209.15571.tldr_zh: 随机插值定义任意两分布间路径，速度场为二次目标唯一极小点；对插值 max-min 可达 Benamou-Brenier OT
2209.15571.tldr_en: Stochastic interpolants define a density path between any two distributions; its velocity minimizes a quadratic loss, and maximizing over interpolants recovers Benamou-Brenier OT.

2210.01253.title: PLOT: Prompt Learning with Optimal Transport for Vision-Language Models
2210.01253.tldr_zh: 用 Sinkhorn OT 对齐局部视觉特征与多 prompt 集合，防止 prompt 坍缩，few-shot 识别超 CoOp
2210.01253.tldr_en: Sinkhorn OT aligns local visual features with multiple prompts to prevent prompt collapse, outperforming CoOp on few-shot recognition

2210.02747.title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
2210.02747.tldr_zh: CFM 目标 simulation-free 训练 CNF，Cond-OT 直线路径在 ImageNet 上似然/FID/NFE 全面优于 diffusion 路径
2210.02747.tldr_en: Conditional Flow Matching trains CNFs simulation-free; conditional-OT straight paths beat diffusion paths on ImageNet in NLL, FID and NFE.

2210.06662.title: Action Matching: Learning Stochastic Dynamics from Samples
2210.06662.tldr_zh: 只用各时刻独立边缘样本学梯度场复现任意密度路径，目标可解、无需耦合或 OT 求解器；含 entropic/unbalanced 扩展
2210.06662.tldr_en: Learns a gradient field reproducing any density path from uncoupled marginal snapshots via a tractable action objective; entropic and unbalanced extensions.

2211.01095.title: DPM-Solver++: Fast Solver for Guided Sampling of Diffusion Probabilistic Models
2211.01095.tldr_zh: 换 data-prediction 参数化+多步+thresholding，解决大 guidance 下高阶求解器失稳，15–20 步完成 guided sampling
2211.01095.tldr_en: Data-prediction parameterization plus multistep and thresholding stabilizes high-order solvers under large guidance, converging in 15-20 steps

2211.01364.title: An optimal control perspective on diffusion-based generative modeling
2211.01364.tldr_zh: 时间反转log密度满足HJB，ELBO=verification theorem；路径空间KL表述与从未归一化密度采样的DIS
2211.01364.tldr_en: Time-reversed log-density solves an HJB equation; ELBO follows from the verification theorem; path-space KL view yields the DIS sampler for unnormalized densities.

2212.01747.title: Fast Point Cloud Generation with Straight Flows
2212.01747.tldr_zh: 把 rectified flow 的 reflow+蒸馏引入点云扩散，一步生成，采样 0.04s，比 PVD 快 700×
2212.01747.tldr_en: Applies rectified flow reflow+distillation to point cloud diffusion, achieving one-step generation at 0.04s, ~700x faster than PVD

2212.03722.title: Optimal transport map estimation in general function spaces
2212.03722.tldr_zh: 半对偶 ERM 推广到任意势类：Poincaré 源+度量熵 ⇒ oracle 不等式 ℓ*+n^{-2/(2+γ)}（强凸更快）；首次覆盖高斯源与 Barron/ICNN 网络 map，并证计算-统计鸿沟
2212.03722.tldr_en: Unified oracle inequalities for semi-dual OT map estimation over arbitrary potential classes under a Poincaré source and metric-entropy control; first rates for Gaussian sources and shallow-network maps, plus a CLWE-based hardness result.

2212.06359.title: Score-based Generative Modeling Secretly Minimizes the Wasserstein Distance
2212.06359.tldr_zh: W2(数据,生成)≤C√J_SM+I(T)W2(p_T,q_T)：score matching损失平方根上界控制W2，证明用连续性方程求W2时间导数
2212.06359.tldr_en: W2(data, generated) <= C sqrt(J_SM) + I(T) W2(p_T,q_T): the score-matching loss upper-bounds the Wasserstein distance via time-derivatives of W2 along continuity equations.

2212.12848.title: Gromov-Wasserstein Distances: Entropic Regularization, Duality, and Sample Complexity
2212.12848.tldr_zh: 用辅助矩阵变量把二次 GW 线性化为 OT/EOT 族下确界，建立首个对偶理论与尖锐经验收敛率
2212.12848.tldr_en: Linearizes quadratic GW via auxiliary matrix into OT/EOT infimum, establishing first duality theory and sharp empirical convergence rates

2212.14424.title: Normalizing flow neural networks by JKO scheme
2212.14424.tldr_zh: JKO-iFlow：CNF 每个残差块解一个 JKO 步，逐块训练免 score matching 与端到端反传，tabular NLL 与 OT-Flow 持平但批数少约 10 倍
2212.14424.tldr_en: JKO-iFlow trains an invertible neural-ODE flow block by block, each block solving one JKO step via a change-of-variables KL objective; no score matching or end-to-end backprop.

2301.12874.title: Extremal Domain Translation with Neural Optimal Transport
2301.12874.tldr_zh: extremal transport 形式化最保真翻译（映到 Supp(Q) 的最近邻），证明它是 incomplete transport T#P<=wQ 在 w->inf 的极限，并给出 max-min 求解器
2301.12874.tldr_en: Extremal transport formalizes the most input-faithful unpaired translation (nearest neighbors in Supp(Q)); it is the w->inf limit of incomplete transport T#P<=wQ, solved by a scalable max-min algorithm.

2302.00482.title: Improving and Generalizing Flow-Based Generative Models with Minibatch Optimal Transport
2302.00482.tldr_zh: 提出 CFM 统一框架与 OT-CFM，batch 内 OT 重配对使流更直、训练更快、2D 上逼近动态 OT。
2302.00482.tldr_en: Generalized conditional flow matching with minibatch OT couplings: straighter flows, faster training, approximates dynamic OT and Schrödinger bridges.

2302.03660.title: Flow Matching on General Geometries
2302.03660.tldr_zh: 用 premetric 闭式构造流形条件向量场，简单几何 simulation-free，首次在网格流形训练 CNF
2302.03660.tldr_en: Riemannian Flow Matching with premetric-based closed-form conditional vector fields; simulation-free on simple geometries, first CNF training on mesh manifolds

2302.04867.title: UniPC: A Unified Predictor-Corrector Framework for Fast Sampling of Diffusion Models
2302.04867.tldr_zh: 统一预测-校正框架 UniPC，校正器零额外 NFE 提升精度，10 步 FID 3.87/7.51
2302.04867.tldr_en: Unified predictor-corrector sampler with zero-extra-NFE corrector, 3.87 FID on CIFAR10 at 10 NFE

2302.04953.title: The Monge Gap: A Regularizer to Learn All Transport Maps
2302.04953.tldr_zh: 用 Monge gap 正则替代 ICNN 约束，任意 cost 下以单目标回归学 OT map，benchmark 上优于基线。
2302.04953.tldr_en: Monge gap regularizer replaces ICNN constraints, enabling single-objective OT map learning for any cost.

2302.05872.title: I2SB: Image-to-Image Schrödinger Bridge
2302.05872.tldr_zh: 配对边界SB可解析、免模拟训练；ImageNet修复7/9项FID最佳
2302.05872.tldr_en: With paired boundaries the Schrödinger bridge becomes tractable and simulation-free; best FID on 7 of 9 ImageNet-256 restoration tasks.

2303.00848.title: Understanding Diffusion Objectives as the ELBO with Simple Data Augmentation
2303.00848.tldr_zh: 所有常用 diffusion/FM 目标是按噪声级加权的 ELBO 积分，权重单调时等于加噪增广下的 ELBO；单调权重在 ImageNet 无引导 FID 最优
2303.00848.tldr_en: All common diffusion/FM losses are weighted integrals of per-noise-level ELBOs; monotonic weighting equals ELBO with Gaussian-noise data augmentation.

2303.01469.title: Consistency Models
2303.01469.tldr_zh: 学习 PF-ODE 的自一致映射（任意轨迹点→起点），蒸馏版 CD 在 CIFAR-10 一步 FID 3.55、两步 2.93。
2303.01469.tldr_en: Consistency models map any PF-ODE trajectory point to its origin; distillation (CD) reaches one-step FID 3.55 on CIFAR-10, training (CT) needs no teacher.

2303.07988.title: Light Unbalanced Optimal Transport
2303.07988.tldr_zh: Gaussian mixture 参数化对偶变量，把连续 UEOT 变成非 minimax 目标，CPU 几分钟求解并给泛化界
2303.07988.tldr_en: Gaussian-mixture dual parametrization turns continuous UEOT into a non-minimax objective with generalization bounds

2303.08797.title: Stochastic Interpolants: A Unifying Framework for Flows and Diffusions
2303.08797.tldr_zh: 插值加潜变量与可调扩散系数，同一路径可 ODE/SDE 采样；SDE 的 KL 受回归损失控制而 ODE 不行；对插值优化得 SB
2303.08797.tldr_en: Interpolants with latent noise and tunable diffusion give ODE/SDE samplers sharing one density path; SDE likelihood is controlled by regression loss, ODE is not; max-min over interpolants yields the Schrodinger bridge.

2303.16852.title: Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge Matching
2303.16852.tldr_zh: 提出 IMF：交替 Markov/reciprocal 投影求 SB，双向 bridge matching 实现（DSBM），每轮保两端边缘
2303.16852.tldr_en: Iterative Markovian Fitting alternates Markovian and reciprocal projections to reach the SB; DSBM implements it with forward/backward bridge matching, preserving both marginals.

2304.06094.title: Energy-guided Entropic Neural Optimal Transport
2304.06094.tldr_zh: 把 EOT 弱对偶写成单势 EBM 目标，条件 plan ∝ exp((f(y)−c(x,y))/ε) 用 Langevin 采样；对偶间隙 = ε·KL(π*‖π^f)，并给 Rademacher 泛化界
2304.06094.tldr_en: Recasts the weak dual of entropic OT as an EBM over a single potential; conditional plans are Gibbs measures sampled by Langevin, with dual gap equal to epsilon times KL and Rademacher generalization bounds.

2304.12824.title: Contrastive Energy Prediction for Exact Energy-Guided Diffusion Sampling in Offline Reinforcement Learning
2304.12824.tldr_zh: 给出中间时刻能量 guidance 的精确形式，用对比学习目标 CEP 估计，D4RL 上超过基线
2304.12824.tldr_en: Exact intermediate energy guidance via contrastive energy prediction; outperforms baselines on D4RL

2304.14772.title: Multisample Flow Matching: Straightening Flows with Minibatch Couplings
2304.14772.tldr_zh: 把 FM 的独立耦合换成 batch 内 OT/稳定匹配耦合，ImageNet 上同 FID 省 30–60% NFE，训练开销 <4%。
2304.14772.tldr_en: Marginal-preserving minibatch couplings (BatchOT/EOT/Stable) for flow matching: lower gradient variance, straighter flows, 30-60% fewer NFEs on ImageNet.

2305.14777.title: Generative Modeling through the Semi-dual Formulation of Unbalanced Optimal Transport
2305.14777.tldr_zh: 用 UOT 半对偶做生成模型，松弛边际约束换 outlier 稳健与训练稳定，CIFAR-10 FID 2.97
2305.14777.tldr_en: UOT semi-dual generative model with relaxed marginal constraints for outlier robustness and stable training; CIFAR-10 FID 2.97

2305.15086.title: Unpaired Image-to-Image Translation via Neural Schrödinger Bridge
2305.15086.tldr_zh: 用SB自相似性拆成对抗学习序列，首次做通高分辨率非配对I2I（据课题笔记）
2305.15086.tldr_en: Decomposes the unpaired Schrödinger bridge into a sequence of adversarial sub-problems via self-similarity; reported first success on high-res unpaired I2I.

2305.16557.title: Tree-Based Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge with Applications to Wasserstein Barycenters
2305.16557.tldr_zh: 把 DSB 推广到树结构多边际 SB，用扩散模型算 Wasserstein barycenter，高维优于正则化基线
2305.16557.tldr_en: Extends DSB to tree-structured multi-marginal SB for Wasserstein barycenters, outperforming regularized baselines in high dimensions

2305.16860.title: Error Bounds for Flow Matching Methods
2305.16860.tldr_zh: 给出 flow matching 确定性采样下 W2 误差界，对 L² 训练误差多项式依赖
2305.16860.tldr_en: W2 error bounds for deterministic flow matching, polynomial in L2 training error

2306.00980.title: SnapFusion: Text-to-Image Diffusion Model on Mobile Devices within Two Seconds
2306.00980.tldr_zh: 架构演化压缩 UNet + 数据蒸馏压 decoder + CFG 正则步蒸馏，iPhone 上 8 步 1.84s，FID/CLIP 优于 50 步 SD-v1.5
2306.00980.tldr_en: Efficient UNet via architecture evolution, distilled decoder, CFG-aware step distillation; 8 steps in 1.84s on iPhone, better FID/CLIP than 50-step SD-v1.5

2306.06626.title: On Kinetic Optimal Probability Paths for Generative Models
2306.06626.tldr_zh: Gaussian 路径族动能只经一维数据分离函数依赖数据；n/sqrt(d)->0 时 Cond-OT 线性路径渐近动能最优
2306.06626.tldr_en: Kinetic energy of affine Gaussian paths depends on data only via a 1-D separation function; Cond-OT linear path is asymptotically kinetic optimal as n/sqrt(d) -> 0.

2306.09099.title: Unbalanced Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge
2306.09099.tldr_zh: 推导带 killing/birth 项 SDE 的时间反演，把 DSB 推广到任意有限质量边缘
2306.09099.tldr_en: Extends DSB to unbalanced marginals via time reversal of SDEs with killing/birth

2306.09341.title: Human Preference Score v2: A Solid Benchmark for Evaluating Human Preferences of Text-to-Image Synthesis
2306.09341.tldr_zh: 79.8万人类偏好对训练CLIP得HPS v2，偏好预测准确率83.3%，建4风格3200 prompt基准
2306.09341.tldr_en: HPS v2 fine-tunes CLIP on 798k human preference pairs, reaching 83.3% accuracy on HPD v2

2306.15030.title: Equivariant flow matching
2306.15030.tldr_zh: 把 batch OT 成本换成旋转+置换对齐后的不变成本，等变 CNF 在小 batch 下逼近 OT 路径
2306.15030.tldr_en: Replaces Euclidean cost in batch OT with rotation+permutation aligned invariant cost for equivariant CNFs

2306.15687.title: Voicebox: Text-Guided Multilingual Universal Speech Generation at Scale
2306.15687.tldr_zh: 50K+小时语音训练文本引导infilling的流匹配模型，统一零样本TTS/编辑/去噪，比VALL-E快20倍
2306.15687.tldr_en: Flow-matching speech infilling model trained on 50K+ hours, unifying zero-shot TTS/editing/denoising, 20x faster than VALL-E

2306.16156.title: Recent Advances in Optimal Transport for Machine Learning
2306.16156.tldr_zh: 2012–2023 OT×ML 应用全景综述，按监督/无监督/迁移/强化四块组织，附计算 OT 五类进展与复杂度对照表
2306.16156.tldr_en: TPAMI survey of OT for ML 2012-2023 across supervised, unsupervised, transfer and RL, plus computational OT extensions (sliced, low-rank, neural, minibatch, unbalanced) with a complexity table.

2307.03672.title: Simulation-Free Schrödinger Bridges via Score and Flow Matching
2307.03672.tldr_zh: 用静态熵正则 OT 耦合加 score/flow 双回归，免模拟求解 Schrödinger bridge
2307.03672.tldr_en: Static entropic OT coupling plus score/flow regression solves Schrödinger bridges simulation-free

2308.03686.title: Nearly $d$-Linear Convergence Bounds for Diffusion Models via Stochastic Localization
2308.03686.tldr_zh: 用随机局部化恒等式把扩散模型 KL 迭代复杂度从 d² 降到 d 线性，仅需有限二阶矩
2308.03686.tldr_en: Stochastic localization reduces diffusion KL iteration complexity to nearly d-linear with only finite second moments

2309.03199.title: Matcha-TTS: A fast TTS architecture with conditional flow matching
2309.03199.tldr_zh: OT-CFM 训练 ODE 解码器 + 1D CNN-Transformer 架构，2 步合成 MOS 超 VITS，内存最小
2309.03199.tldr_en: OT-CFM-trained ODE decoder with 1D CNN-Transformer U-Net achieves 2-step synthesis surpassing VITS MOS with smallest memory

2309.06380.title: InstaFlow: One Step is Enough for High-Quality Diffusion-Based Text-to-Image Generation
2309.06380.tldr_zh: 文本条件 reflow 理顺 SD 噪声-图像耦合后蒸馏，首个 SD 级一步文生图：COCO-5k FID 23.4，199 A100 天
2309.06380.tldr_en: Text-conditioned reflow refines Stable Diffusion's noise-image coupling so one-step distillation works: COCO-5k FID 23.4 in 0.09s, 199 A100 GPU days.

2309.11713.title: Quasi-Monte Carlo for 3D Sliced Wasserstein
2309.11713.tldr_zh: 用球面 QMC 点集替代 MC 投影方向，QSW 降近似误差，RQSW 随机化后保无偏可做 SGD
2309.11713.tldr_en: Replaces MC projection directions with spherical QMC point sets; QSW reduces approximation error, RQSW adds randomization for unbiased SGD

2309.16948.title: Denoising Diffusion Bridge Models
2309.16948.tldr_zh: 去噪桥分数匹配学VE/VP扩散桥时间反演，配对翻译FID 1.83远超I2SB
2309.16948.tldr_en: Learns the time-reversal of VE/VP diffusion bridges via denoising bridge score matching; paired translation FID 1.83 on Edges-to-Handbags.

2310.01105.title: Energy-Guided Continuous Entropic Barycenter Estimation for General Costs
2310.01105.tldr_zh: 弱 OT 对偶+EBM 训练求解连续熵正则 barycenter，支持任意代价，免 min-max，带质量界
2310.01105.tldr_en: Weak OT dual + EBM training solves continuous entropic barycenters for general costs, with quality bounds

2310.01174.title: Light Schrödinger Bridge (LightSB), Korotin et al.
2310.01174.tldr_zh: 高斯混合参数化 Schrödinger 势，免仿真、CPU 分钟级求解 SB，并证万能逼近性
2310.01174.tldr_en: Gaussian mixture parametrization of Schrödinger potentials enables simulation-free, CPU-minute SB solving with universal approximation

2310.02279.title: Consistency Trajectory Models: Learning Probability Flow ODE Trajectory of Diffusion
2310.02279.tldr_zh: 学 PF-ODE 任意时刻→任意时刻跳跃并兼得 score，加 DSM+GAN 后一步 FID 1.98/1.73（CIFAR-10）、1.92（ImageNet-64）。
2310.02279.tldr_en: CTM learns anytime-to-anytime PF-ODE jumps plus the score in one network; with DSM and GAN losses it reaches one-step FID 1.73 (CIFAR-10 cond.) and 1.92 (ImageNet-64).

2310.02391.title: SE(3)-Stochastic Flow Matching for Protein Backbone Generation
2310.02391.tldr_zh: SE(3)^N 上流匹配蛋白骨架生成，OT 耦合提设计性，随机桥提新颖性
2310.02391.tldr_en: Flow matching on SE(3)^N for protein backbones; OT coupling boosts designability, stochastic bridges boost novelty

2310.02611.title: Analyzing and Improving Optimal-Transport-based Adversarial Networks
2310.02611.tldr_zh: 统一 OT-based GAN 框架；α 调度 UOTM-SD 缓解 τ 敏感，CIFAR-10 FID 2.51
2310.02611.tldr_en: Unifies OT-based GANs; α-scheduled UOTM-SD reduces τ sensitivity, FID 2.51 on CIFAR-10

2310.03725.title: Stochastic Interpolants with Data-Dependent Couplings
2310.03725.tldr_zh: 把 base 写成目标的退化观测 x0=m(x1)+σζ，同一平方回归学速度场；ImageNet 补全 FID 1.13 vs 独立耦合 1.35，64→256 超分 FID 2.05
2310.03725.tldr_en: Base samples are degraded observations of the target, x0=m(x1)+sigma*zeta; same square-loss training; ImageNet inpainting FID 1.13 vs 1.35 independent, 64->256 SR FID 2.05.

2310.09254.title: GENOT: Entropic (Gromov) Wasserstein Flow Matching with Applications to Single-Cell Genomics
2310.09254.tldr_zh: 条件 FM 学熵 OT 耦合的条件分布，支持任意成本、unbalanced 与 (F)GW 跨空间翻译
2310.09254.tldr_en: Conditional flow matching learns entropic OT couplings for any cost, unbalanced and (F)GW settings

2310.11513.title: GenEval: An Object-Focused Framework for Evaluating Text-to-Image Alignment
2310.11513.tldr_zh: 用现成目标检测器+CLIP做六任务组合评测，人评一致率83%，已成端侧标配指标
2310.11513.tldr_en: Object-detector-based compositional T2I evaluation with 83% human agreement, now standard in on-device papers

2310.13268.title: DPM-Solver-v3: Improved Diffusion ODE Solver with Empirical Model Statistics
2310.13268.tldr_zh: 用经验模型统计量自动选最优参数化，5–10 NFE 下优于 DPM-Solver++ 与 UniPC
2310.13268.tldr_en: Empirical model statistics select optimal parameterization, improving 5-10 NFE sampling over prior solvers

2310.14189.title: Improved Techniques for Training Consistency Models
2310.14189.tldr_zh: 去掉 teacher EMA、换 Pseudo-Huber 与对数正态噪声调度，免蒸馏 CT 一步 FID 2.51（CIFAR-10），首次反超 CD。
2310.14189.tldr_en: Zero teacher EMA, Pseudo-Huber loss, lognormal noise schedule and exponential N curriculum let distillation-free CT reach one-step FID 2.51 on CIFAR-10, beating CD.

2310.16338.title: Generative Pre-training for Speech with Flow Matching
2310.16338.tldr_zh: FM+masked 条件在 6 万小时无标注语音上预训练 SpeechFlow，微调后匹配或超过增强/分离/TTS 专家模型
2310.16338.tldr_en: FM with masked conditions pretrained on 60k hrs unlabeled speech; fine-tuning matches or beats expert models on enhancement, separation, TTS

2310.16834.title: Discrete Diffusion Modeling by Estimating the Ratios of the Data Distribution
2310.16834.tldr_zh: 提出 score entropy 学习离散概率比值，扩散 LM 首次在困惑度上超过 GPT-2，可 32× 减少采样步数
2310.16834.tldr_en: Score entropy learns probability ratios for discrete diffusion, first diffusion LM to beat GPT-2 perplexity with 32x fewer sampling steps

2310.16975.title: Efficient Neural Network Approaches for Conditional Optimal Transport with Applications in Bayesian Inference
2310.16975.tldr_zh: 静态 PCP-Map 与动态 COT-Flow 两种神经条件 OT 求解器，最大似然训练，用于 likelihood-free 贝叶斯推断
2310.16975.tldr_en: Two neural conditional OT solvers (static PCP-Map, dynamic COT-Flow) trained by maximum likelihood for likelihood-free Bayesian inference

2310.19075.title: Bespoke Solvers for Generative Flow Models
2310.19075.tldr_zh: 对预训练流模型学 scale-time 变换+RK 的定制求解器（约 80 参数、约 1% 训练算力），CIFAR-10 10 NFE FID 2.73，ImageNet-64 20 NFE 距 GT 2%
2310.19075.tldr_en: Learns a tiny scale-time-transformed RK solver per pretrained flow (about 80 params, about 1% train compute): CIFAR-10 FID 2.73 at 10 NFE, ImageNet-64 within 2% of GT at 20 NFE.

2311.01226.title: Optimal Transport-Guided Conditional Score-Based Diffusion Models
2311.01226.tldr_zh: 用 L2 正则 OT 估计非配对/半配对数据耦合，按相容性重采样训练条件分数模型，实现 OT 数据传输
2311.01226.tldr_en: L2-regularized OT estimates coupling for unpaired/semi-paired data; resampling-by-compatibility trains conditional SBDM to realize OT transport

2311.03886.title: Formulating Discrete Probability Flow Through Optimal Transport
2311.03886.tldr_zh: 共线数据下连续PF有限区间是Monge映射；ReLU单向流生成元定义离散probability flow，CIFAR-10 CSD 57.7→9.4
2311.03886.tldr_en: Continuous PF is a Monge map on finite intervals for collinear data; a one-directional ReLU generator defines discrete probability flow, cutting CIFAR-10 CSD from 57.7 to 9.4.

2311.05672.title: Conditional Optimal Transport on Function Spaces
2311.05672.tldr_zh: 无穷维函数空间上条件 OT 的存在性、对偶与 Monge 唯一性，用于 amortized Bayesian 推断
2311.05672.tldr_en: Existence, duality, and Monge uniqueness of conditional OT on function spaces for amortized Bayesian inference

2311.15100.title: Unbalancedness in Neural Monge Maps Improves Unpaired Domain Translation
2311.15100.tldr_zh: 证明 unbalanced Monge map 等价于重缩放测度间的 balanced map，可插入任意估计器；UOT-FM 在图像翻译上优于 OT-FM
2311.15100.tldr_en: Unbalanced Monge map equals balanced map between rescaled measures; UOT-FM improves unpaired image translation over OT-FM

2311.16567.title: MobileDiffusion: Instant Text-to-Image Generation on Mobile Devices
2311.16567.tldr_zh: 系统搜索 <400M 参数 UNet 架构 + UFOGen 一步采样，iPhone 15 Pro 上 0.2s 生成 512² 图像
2311.16567.tldr_en: Systematic UNet architecture search under 400M params plus UFOGen one-step sampling, achieving 0.2s 512² generation on iPhone 15 Pro

2311.17042.title: Adversarial Diffusion Distillation
2311.17042.tldr_zh: hinge-GAN 判别器 + SDS 型 score 蒸馏把 SD/SDXL 压到 1–4 步；人评中 ADD-XL 一步胜 LCM-XL 四步、四步胜 SDXL 五十步。
2311.17042.tldr_en: ADD combines a DINOv2-feature hinge GAN with an SDS-equivalent teacher denoising loss to distill SD/SDXL into 1-4 steps; ADD-XL beats LCM-XL (4 steps) in one step and SDXL (50 steps) in four steps by human preference.

2311.18828.title: One-step Diffusion with Distribution Matching Distillation
2311.18828.tldr_zh: 反向 KL 梯度 = 真/假 score 之差，加教师 ODE 噪声-图像对回归锚定，一步 ImageNet-64 FID 2.62、COCO-30k 11.49。
2311.18828.tldr_en: DMD trains a one-step generator with a reverse-KL gradient (real minus fake score) plus LPIPS regression on teacher ODE noise-image pairs: FID 2.62 on ImageNet-64, 11.49 zero-shot COCO.

2312.00094.title: Fast ODE-based Sampling for Diffusion Models in Around 5 Steps
2312.00094.tldr_zh: 轨迹近似 2D，学 9k 参数预测器给每步平均方向，5 NFE CIFAR-10 FID 6.61
2312.00094.tldr_en: Trajectories are nearly 2D; a 9k-parameter predictor learns per-step mean direction, reaching FID 6.61 on CIFAR-10 at 5 NFE.

2312.00739.title: Adversarial Score Distillation: When score distillation meets GAN
2312.00739.tldr_zh: 把 SDS/VSD 重写为 WGAN 生成器损失：SDS 用固定次优判别器、VSD 判别器优化不完整；补全判别器损失后 2D/3D 蒸馏更稳。
2312.00739.tldr_en: ASD rederives SDS/VSD as WGAN generator losses with a diffusion-parameterized log-ratio discriminator, shows SDS uses a fixed suboptimal discriminator and VSD an incomplete update, and completes the discriminator loss.

2312.02027.title: Stochastic Optimal Control Matching
2312.02027.tldr_zh: 把随机最优控制变成最小二乘回归，用 path-wise reparameterization trick 降方差，4 个控制问题中 3 个取得最低 L2 误差。
2312.02027.tldr_en: Casts stochastic optimal control as least-squares regression with a path-wise reparameterization trick for variance reduction; lowest L2 error on 3 of 4 control problems.

2312.03491.title: Schrodinger Bridges Beat Diffusion Models on Text-to-Speech Synthesis
2312.03491.tldr_zh: 用文本潜变量替换高斯先验，配对数据上完全可解 SB，2-4 步合成超 Grad-TTS 与快速 TTS 基线
2312.03491.tldr_en: Replaces Gaussian prior with text latent in a fully tractable paired-data Schrodinger bridge; 2-4 step TTS beats Grad-TTS and fast baselines

2312.07311.title: Scalable Motion Style Transfer with Constrained Diffusion Generation
2312.07311.tldr_zh: 各风格域独立训练扩散模型，DDIB桥接加关键帧流形约束梯度，实现十种舞蹈风格迁移
2312.07311.tldr_en: Independently trained diffusion models per style domain, bridged by DDIB with keyframe manifold constraint gradients for 10 dance styles

2312.14572.title: Semidefinite Relaxations of the Gromov-Wasserstein Distance
2312.14572.tldr_zh: 用 SDP 松弛 GW 非凸 QP，给出可认证全局下界与最优性证书，实验中频繁达到全局最优
2312.14572.tldr_en: SDP relaxation of GW gives certifiable global lower bounds and optimality certificates, frequently exact in experiments

2312.16414.title: Bellman Optimal Stepsize Straightening of Flow-Matching Models
2312.16414.tldr_zh: 动态规划求 K 步最优非均匀 Euler 步长，再按步长把速度场拉成分段直线；6 NFE 下 256×256 数据 FID 约为 reflow 一半，LoRA 2% 参数即可
2312.16414.tldr_en: Dynamic programming finds Bellman-optimal non-uniform Euler stepsizes; retraining the velocity along them halves 6-NFE FID vs reflow on 256x256 datasets with only 12k iterations or 2% LoRA params.

2401.04082.title: Improved motif-scaffolding with SE(3) flow matching
2401.04082.tldr_zh: FrameFlow 扩展出 motif amortization 与免重训 motif guidance，多样性达 RFdiffusion 的 2.5 倍
2401.04082.tldr_en: Extends FrameFlow with motif amortization and training-free motif guidance, achieving 2.5x diversity over RFdiffusion

2401.08740.title: SiT: Exploring Flow and Diffusion-based Generative Models with Scalable Interpolant Transformers
2401.08740.tldr_zh: DiT 骨干不改参数，逐项切换连续时间/速度预测/Linear 插值/可调 w_t SDE 采样，ImageNet-256 FID 2.27→2.06、512 上 2.62
2401.08740.tldr_en: On an unchanged DiT backbone, switching to continuous time, velocity prediction, linear interpolant and tunable-diffusion SDE sampling lowers ImageNet-256 FID from 2.27 to 2.06 (2.62 at 512).

2401.09603.title: Rethinking FID: Towards a Better Evaluation Metric for Image Generation
2401.09603.tldr_zh: FID 正态假设不成立、样本效率差且与人评矛盾；提出 CLIP+MMD 的 CMMD 替代
2401.09603.tldr_en: FID's normality assumption fails and contradicts human raters; CMMD uses CLIP embeddings with MMD as a robust alternative

2401.12253.title: Accelerating Sinkhorn Algorithm with Sparse Newton Iterations
2401.12253.tldr_zh: Sinkhorn 预热后接 Hessian 稀疏化的 Newton 迭代，每迭代 O(n²)，迭代数大幅减少
2401.12253.tldr_en: Sparse Newton stage after Sinkhorn warm-start cuts iterations with O(n²) per-iteration cost

2402.03828.title: Estimating Barycenters of Distributions with Neural Optimal Transport
2402.03828.tldr_zh: 用 Neural OT 对偶把 barycenter 写成双层 max-min，支持一般代价，含恢复计划质量界
2402.03828.tldr_en: Bi-level max-min Neural OT objective for Wasserstein barycenters with general costs and recovery bounds

2402.04997.title: Generative Flows on Discrete State-Spaces: Enabling Multimodal Flows with Applications to Protein Co-Design
2402.04997.tldr_zh: 用 CTMC 实现离散 flow matching，与 FrameFlow 组合成 Multiflow，co-design designability 达 0.86
2402.04997.tldr_en: Discrete flow matching via CTMCs, combined with FrameFlow into Multiflow for protein co-design, achieving 0.86 co-design designability

2402.05443.title: Scalable Wasserstein Gradient Flow for Generative Modeling through Unbalanced Optimal Transport
2402.05443.tldr_zh: S-JKO：JKO 步 = 源端固定 UOT，半对偶 + 重参数化把训练降到 O(K)，CIFAR-10 FID 2.62、CelebA-HQ-256 FID 5.46，一步采样
2402.05443.tldr_en: S-JKO shows each JKO step is a source-fixed UOT problem, solves it via the UOT semi-dual with a reparametrized map T_k = dT_k o T_{k-1}, reducing training to O(K); FID 2.62 on CIFAR-10 with one-step sampling.

2402.06162.title: Wasserstein proximal operators describe score-based generative models and resolve memorization
2402.06162.tldr_zh: SGM 是交叉熵的 Wasserstein 近端算子；核模型匹配 HJB 终端条件可避免记忆化
2402.06162.tldr_en: SGMs are Wasserstein proximal operators of cross-entropy; kernel model with HJB terminal condition avoids memorization

2402.07747.title: Optimal score estimation via empirical Bayes smoothing
2402.07747.tldr_zh: 确立 Lipschitz score 估计的 minimax 率 n^{-2/(d+4)}，Gaussian 核正则化 KDE 达到上界
2402.07747.tldr_en: Establishes minimax rate n^{-2/(d+4)} for Lipschitz score estimation via regularized Gaussian KDE

2402.07802.title: Towards a mathematical theory for consistency training in diffusion models
2402.07802.tldr_zh: 证明一致性训练步数超 O(d^{5/2}/ε) 即可使一步采样 W1 距离 ε-接近目标
2402.07802.tldr_en: Proves consistency training with >O(d^{5/2}/ε) steps yields one-step samples ε-close in W1

2402.08095.title: Convergence Analysis of Discrete Diffusion Model: Exact Implementation through Uniformization
2402.08095.tldr_zh: 用 CTMC uniformization 精确模拟反向链，给出超立方体上 TV/KL 收敛保证，对齐连续扩散最优结果
2402.08095.tldr_en: Exact reverse CTMC simulation via uniformization yields TV/KL convergence guarantees on hypercube, matching continuous diffusion optimal results

2402.12030.title: Towards Cross-Tokenizer Distillation: the Universal Logit Distillation Loss for LLMs
2402.12030.tldr_zh: 用排序概率向量的 W1 距离做跨词表 logit 蒸馏，作者报告平均比纯文本蒸馏高 2.30 点 F1
2402.12030.tldr_en: Cross-tokenizer logit distillation via sorted-probability W1 distance; authors report +2.30 avg F1 over text-only distillation

2402.15602.title: Minimax Optimality of Score-based Diffusion Models: Beyond the Density Lower Bound Assumptions
2402.15602.tldr_zh: 截断核 score 估计器在仅次高斯假设下达到最优 MSE，去掉密度下界后 β≤2 Sobolev 类扩散模型仍近 minimax
2402.15602.tldr_en: Truncated kernel score estimator achieves optimal MSE under sub-Gaussianity; diffusion model is nearly minimax for β≤2 Sobolev class without density lower bound

2402.17110.title: Sinkhorn Distance Minimization for Knowledge Distillation
2402.17110.tldr_zh: 用 Sinkhorn 距离替代 KL/RKL/JS 做 logits 蒸馏，批级重构感知分布几何
2402.17110.tldr_en: Sinkhorn distance replaces KL/RKL/JS for logits distillation with batch-wise OT reformulation

2402.17376.title: Accelerating Diffusion Sampling with Optimized Time Steps
2402.17376.tldr_zh: 把时间步选取写成最小化全局离散误差上界的约束优化，与 UniPC 即插即用，5 NFE 下 FID 大幅下降
2402.17376.tldr_en: Optimizes time steps by minimizing a global discretization error bound via constrained trust region, plug-and-play with UniPC

2403.01329.title: Bespoke Non-Stationary Solvers for Fast Sampling of Diffusion and Flow Models
2403.01329.tldr_zh: 用<200参数的定制非平稳求解器蒸馏，16 NFE在ImageNet-64达45 PSNR/1.76 FID
2403.01329.tldr_en: Distills <200-param non-stationary solvers; 16 NFE hits 45 PSNR/1.76 FID on ImageNet-64

2403.01639.title: Theoretical Insights for Diffusion Guidance: A Case Study for Gaussian Mixture Models
2403.01639.tldr_zh: GMM 下证明 guidance 提升分类置信度、降低微分熵，覆盖 DDPM/DDIM
2403.01639.tldr_en: Proves guidance boosts classification confidence and reduces differential entropy in GMMs, covering DDPM/DDIM

2403.01781.title: Integrating Efficient Optimal Transport and Functional Maps For Unsupervised Shape Correspondence Learning
2403.01781.tldr_zh: 用 sliced Wasserstein 距离替代 Sinkhorn 做无监督形状对应特征对齐，加自适应精化，在多个非刚性匹配基准上超过 ULRSSM
2403.01781.tldr_en: Replaces Sinkhorn with sliced Wasserstein distance for unsupervised shape correspondence feature alignment, plus adaptive refinement, outperforming ULRSSM on several non-rigid matching benchmarks

2403.03206.title: Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
2403.03206.tldr_zh: 61 变体对照确立 RF+logit-normal 时间步采样最优，MMDiT 架构随规模可预测提升
2403.03206.tldr_en: Large-scale study establishes RF with logit-normal timestep sampling as superior; MMDiT scales predictably

2403.03777.title: ENOT: Expectile Regularization for Fast and Accurate Training of Neural Optimal Transport
2403.03777.tldr_zh: 用 expectile 回归正则隐式逼近 c-conjugate（τ→1 收敛到 sup），免内层优化；W2 benchmark 误差最多降 3 倍、时间最多快 10 倍
2403.03777.tldr_en: Expectile regression on dual potentials implicitly approximates the c-conjugate without inner optimization; up to 3x lower error and 10x faster on the Wasserstein-2 benchmark.

2403.05069.title: Improving Diffusion-Based Generative Models via Approximated Optimal Transport
2403.05069.tldr_zh: EDM 训练时 batch 内 Hungarian 图像–噪声指派近似 OT，ODE 曲率下降；CIFAR-10 FID 1.88@27NFE、加 DG 1.68/1.58
2403.05069.tldr_en: Hungarian image-noise assignment during EDM training approximates OT, straightens ODE; CIFAR-10 FID 1.88 at 27 NFE, 1.68/1.58 with discriminator guidance.

2403.06069.title: Implicit Image-to-Image Schrödinger Bridge for Image Restoration
2403.06069.tldr_zh: 把 I2SB 采样改为非马尔可夫、每步注入初始退化图，免重训复用预训练模型，少步数下 FID 与保真度同时改善
2403.06069.tldr_en: Non-Markovian I2SB sampling injecting the corrupted image at each step, reusing pretrained models, better FID and fidelity with fewer steps

2403.11262.title: Understanding Diffusion Models by Feynman's Path Integral
2403.11262.tldr_zh: 路径积分表述扩散模型，WKB 展开计算带噪采样 NLL，量化噪声收益
2403.11262.tldr_en: Path integral formulation of diffusion models; WKB expansion computes NLL for noisy sampling

2403.14183.title: OTSeg: Multi-prompt Sinkhorn Attention for Zero-Shot Semantic Segmentation
2403.14183.tldr_zh: Sinkhorn 替换跨注意力归一化，多 prompt 全局匹配像素语义，ZS3 三基准 SOTA
2403.14183.tldr_en: Sinkhorn replaces cross-attention softmax for multi-prompt pixel matching, SOTA on ZS3

2403.16627.title: SDXS: Real-Time One-Step Latent Diffusion Models with Image Conditions
2403.16627.tldr_zh: UNet+VAE 双小型化 + 特征匹配/分数蒸馏一步训练，512² 约 100 FPS，1024² 约 30 FPS
2403.16627.tldr_en: Dual miniaturization of UNet and VAE plus feature-matching/score-distillation one-step training; ~100 FPS at 512², ~30 FPS at 1024²

2403.18705.title: Conditional Wasserstein Distances with Applications in Bayesian OT Flow Matching
2403.18705.tldr_zh: 受限耦合定义条件 W2=后验 W2 期望；速度场 Y 分量为零，给出 Bayesian OT-FM
2403.18705.tldr_en: Restricted-coupling conditional W2 equals expected posterior W2; velocity field has zero Y-component; yields Bayesian OT-FM

2403.19655.title: GaussianCube: A Structured and Explicit Radiance Representation for 3D Generative Modeling
2403.19655.tldr_zh: 定数化 3DGS 拟合后用 OT 线性指派把 Gaussians 摆进 voxel 网格，使标准 3D U-Net 扩散可直接生成 3D 资产
2403.19655.tldr_en: Fits fixed-count 3DGS then uses OT assignment to arrange Gaussians into voxel grid, enabling standard 3D U-Net diffusion for 3D generation

2404.04240.title: Dynamic Conditional Optimal Transport through Simulation-Free Flows
2404.04240.tldr_zh: 证明条件 OT 的动态形式（条件版 Benamou-Brenier），用三角 COT 耦合做 simulation-free 条件生成，适用无穷维 Bayesian 逆问题
2404.04240.tldr_en: Proves a dynamical conditional OT formulation (conditional Benamou-Brenier) and builds a simulation-free conditional generative model via triangular COT couplings, applicable to infinite-dimensional Bayesian inverse problems

2404.04650.title: InitNO: Boosting Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Initial Noise Optimization
2404.04650.tldr_zh: 首步注意力分划分有效/无效噪声区，带 KL 高斯约束的仿射优化把初值推进有效区；SD1.4 用户研究 63.33%，耗时 2.3×
2404.04650.tldr_en: Scores initial noise by first-step cross/self-attention, optimizes an affine reparameterization with KL-to-Gaussian penalty into the valid region; SD1.4, 2.3x slower.

2404.11741.title: Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge Models for High-Quality MR-to-CT Synthesis for Head and Neck Proton Treatment Planning
2404.11741.tldr_zh: I2SB 配对桥做头颈 MR→CT，46 例训练 1–3 步即胜 pix2pix/nnU-Net，像素 MAE 降 5 HU 但 gamma 仅升 0.1 pp
2404.11741.tldr_en: I2SB-style paired bridge for head-and-neck MR-to-CT; 1-3 steps beat pix2pix/nnU-Net on MAE/Dice, yet proton gamma pass rate improves by only 0.1 pp.

2404.11925.title: EdgeFusion: On-Device Text-to-Image Generation
2404.11925.tldr_zh: BK-SDM-Tiny+改进LCM蒸馏+合成数据，W8A16量化+MLT，Exynos 2400 NPU上2步<1s
2404.11925.tldr_en: Compact SD with improved LCM distillation and synthetic data runs 2-step T2I under 1s on Exynos NPU

2404.14507.title: Align Your Steps: Optimizing Sampling Schedules in Diffusion Models
2404.14507.tldr_zh: Girsanov 导出 KL 上界 KLUB，按模型×求解器×数据优化调度；CIFAR-10 10 NFE 5.07→2.98
2404.14507.tldr_en: Minimizes a Girsanov-derived KL upper bound (KLUB) between true and linearized generative SDEs to optimize schedules; CIFAR-10 10-NFE FID 5.07 to 2.98.

2405.06789.title: Self-Consistent Recursive Diffusion Bridge for Medical Image Translation
2405.06789.tldr_zh: 配对扩散桥终点改为加噪源图（方差单调递增软先验）+ 每步递归自洽估计 x0，多对比 MRI/MRI→CT 上 PSNR 高 SynDiff 1.2–1.5 dB
2405.06789.tldr_en: Paired diffusion bridge whose end-point is a noised source image (monotone variance, soft prior) plus self-consistent recursive x0 estimation; +1.2-1.5 dB PSNR over SynDiff/DDPM on MRI and MRI-CT.

2405.07510.title: PeRFlow: Piecewise Rectified Flow as Universal Plug-and-Play Accelerator
2405.07510.tldr_zh: 4 时间窗内对真实图像加噪做短程 reflow，免整轨迹合成、可在线训练；ΔW 即插即用加速 SD 生态，4 步 FID 优于 LCM-LoRA
2405.07510.tldr_en: Piecewise reflow within 4 time windows starting from noised real images avoids full-trajectory synthesis; the weight delta plugs into SD pipelines, beating LCM-LoRA at 4 steps.

2405.11326.title: On the Trajectory Regularity of ODE-based Diffusion Sampling
2405.11326.tldr_zh: PF-ODE轨迹与内容无关呈线性-非线性-线性形、近落3维子空间；GITS动态规划时间表5-10 NFE大幅降FID
2405.11326.tldr_en: PF-ODE sampling trajectories share a content-independent linear-nonlinear-linear shape in a ~3-D subspace; GITS DP time schedule cuts FID at 5-10 NFE.

2405.14250.title: Diffusion models for Gaussian distributions: Exact solutions and Wasserstein errors
2405.14250.tldr_zh: 高斯数据下逆向SDE/PF-ODE及离散格式闭式解，精确W2误差分解；SDE抗初始化误差，Heun最优
2405.14250.tldr_en: Closed-form reverse SDE/PF-ODE and discretizations for Gaussian data; exact W2 error decomposition; SDE robust to init error, Heun best ODE scheme.

2405.14449.title: ASBM: Adversarial Schrödinger Bridge Matching
2405.14449.tldr_zh: 离散时间IMF只学少数转移并用DD-GAN实现，几步达连续IMF百步质量
2405.14449.tldr_en: Discrete-time IMF learns a few transition kernels with DD-GANs, matching hundred-step continuous IMF quality in a few steps on unpaired translation.

2405.14664.title: Fisher Flow Matching for Generative Modeling over Discrete Data
2405.14664.tldr_zh: 把离散类别分布嵌入 Fisher-Rao 球面正象限做流匹配，用黎曼 OT 耦合改善训练，在 DNA 与 LM1B 上优于离散扩散基线
2405.14664.tldr_en: Embeds categorical distributions into Fisher-Rao sphere positive orthant for flow matching with Riemannian OT coupling, outperforming discrete diffusion baselines on DNA and LM1B

2405.14780.title: Metric Flow Matching for Smooth Interpolations on the Data Manifold
2405.14780.tldr_zh: 用数据依赖黎曼度量的近似测地线替代 CFM 直线插值，路径贴合流形，单细胞轨迹 SOTA
2405.14780.tldr_en: Replaces straight CFM interpolants with approximate geodesics of a data-dependent Riemannian metric, keeping paths on the data manifold

2405.15506.title: Learning to Discretize Denoising Diffusion ODEs
2405.15506.tldr_zh: 可微反传学生端点 LPIPS 误差 + 软教师强制学时间步，单卡分钟级；CIFAR-10 10 NFE FID 2.38
2405.15506.tldr_en: Learns time discretization by backpropagating endpoint LPIPS error with soft teacher forcing; minutes on one GPU; CIFAR-10 FID 2.38 at 10 NFE.

2405.15885.title: Diffusion Bridge Implicit Models
2405.15885.tldr_zh: 非马尔可夫桥得DDIM式免训练采样器，20 NFE胜DDBM 500 NFE
2405.15885.tldr_en: Non-Markovian bridges sharing DDBM marginals yield a DDIM-style training-free sampler; 20 NFE beats DDBM at 500 NFE on ImageNet inpainting.

2405.16381.title: Trivialized Momentum Facilitates Diffusion Generative Modeling on Lie Groups
2405.16381.tldr_zh: 李群上用平凡化动量把 score 学习搬到固定李代数，首次生成高维 SO(n)/U(n) 数据
2405.16381.tldr_en: Trivialized momentum moves score learning to a fixed Lie algebra, enabling first high-dim SO(n)/U(n) generation

2405.17873.title: MixDQ: Memory-Efficient Few-Step Text-to-Image Diffusion Models with Metric-Decoupled Mixed Precision Quantization
2405.17873.tldr_zh: 少步扩散量化瓶颈在文本嵌入BOS离群值；BOS跳过+指标解耦+整数规划配比特，W4A8仅+0.5 FID
2405.17873.tldr_en: Few-step diffusion quantization bottlenecked by BOS outliers; BOS-skip + metric-decoupled sensitivity + integer programming achieves W4A8 with +0.5 FID

2405.18750.title: T2V-Turbo: Breaking the Quality Bottleneck of Video Consistency Model with Mixed Reward Feedback
2405.18750.tldr_zh: VCM 蒸馏中混入图文/视频文本奖励反馈，4 步 VBench 总分超 Gen-2 与 Pika
2405.18750.tldr_en: Mixed image/video-text reward feedback in VCM distillation; 4-step VBench total score surpasses Gen-2 and Pika

2405.20313.title: Sequence-Augmented SE(3)-Flow Matching For Conditional Protein Backbone Generation
2405.20313.tldr_zh: FoldFlow-2 用 pLM 序列条件化 SE(3)-FM，无条件生成全面超 RFDiffusion，并解锁折叠与 scaffolding
2405.20313.tldr_en: FoldFlow-2 conditions SE(3)-flow matching on pLM-encoded sequences, outperforming RFDiffusion on unconditional generation and enabling folding/scaffolding

2405.20320.title: Improving the Training of Rectified Flows
2405.20320.tldr_zh: 一轮 reflow 即近乎直；U 形时间步 + LPIPS-Huber 前度量，CIFAR-10 一步 FID 12.21→3.07，ImageNet-64 一步 4.31 超 CD/PD
2405.20320.tldr_en: One reflow round suffices under realistic settings; U-shaped timestep distribution and LPIPS-Huber premetric cut CIFAR-10 one-step FID 12.21->3.07 and beat CD/PD on ImageNet-64.

2405.20879.title: Flow matching achieves almost minimax optimal convergence
2405.20879.tldr_zh: 高斯条件核 FM 在 Besov 类上 W_r(1≤r≤2) 率 n^{-(s+1/(2κ)-δ)/(2s+d)}，σ_t≍√t 时几乎 minimax，与扩散持平
2405.20879.tldr_en: Gaussian-kernel flow matching attains W_r rate n^{-(s+1/(2k)-delta)/(2s+d)} on Besov densities; almost minimax iff sigma_t ~ sqrt(t), matching diffusion models.

2406.03736.title: Your Absorbing Discrete Diffusion Secretly Models the Conditional Distributions of Clean Data
2406.03736.tldr_zh: 证明 absorbing 扩散的 concrete score 可分解为条件分布×时间标量，与任意序 AR 等价，支持缓存加速
2406.03736.tldr_en: Absorbing diffusion concrete score factorizes into clean conditional distribution times analytic time scalar, unifying with AO-ARMs and enabling caching

2406.04312.title: ReNO: Enhancing One-step Text-to-Image Models through Reward-based Noise Optimization
2406.04312.tldr_zh: 一步模型上以四个偏好 reward 之和对初始噪声做 50 步梯度上升（20–50 s），SD-Turbo GenEval 0.49→0.62
2406.04312.tldr_en: Gradient-ascent on initial noise of one-step T2I models with a sum of four preference rewards; 50 steps, 20-50 s, GenEval 0.49 to 0.62 for SD-Turbo.

2406.04329.title: Simplified and Generalized Masked Diffusion for Discrete Data
2406.04329.tldr_zh: masked diffusion 的 ELBO 化简为加权交叉熵积分，GenMD4 引入状态依赖 schedule，像素级建模超同规模 AR
2406.04329.tldr_en: Simplifies masked diffusion ELBO to weighted cross-entropy integral; GenMD4 adds state-dependent schedules; pixel modeling beats similar-size AR

2406.04333.title: BitsFusion: 1.99 bits Weight Quantization of Diffusion Model
2406.04333.tldr_zh: QAT 把 SD-v1.5 UNet 压到 1.99 bit，CLIP/TIFA/GenEval/人评反超全精度
2406.04333.tldr_en: QAT compresses SD-v1.5 UNet to 1.99 bits, outperforming full precision on CLIP/TIFA/GenEval/human eval

2406.04713.title: FlowMM: Generating Materials with Riemannian Flow Matching
2406.04713.tldr_zh: 晶体环面+晶格+种类联合流形上做黎曼流匹配，CSP匹配率61.39%，找稳定材料积分步数省约3倍
2406.04713.tldr_en: Riemannian FM on torus+lattice+species manifold for crystals; 61.39% CSP match rate, ~3x fewer integration steps for stable materials

2406.05061.title: Progressive Entropic Optimal Transport Solvers
2406.05061.tldr_zh: 沿 McCann 插值把 Sinkhorn 拆成 K 段并调度 ε_k、α_k，得到对 ε 不敏感、可证一致的 map/耦合估计器 ProgOT
2406.05061.tldr_en: ProgOT splits entropic OT into K Sinkhorn steps along a McCann interpolation with scheduled epsilon, giving a consistent, epsilon-robust map and coupling estimator.

2406.07524.title: Simple and Effective Masked Diffusion Language Models
2406.07524.tldr_zh: masked diffusion 的 ELBO 化简为加权 MLM 交叉熵，工程化训练后扩散 LM 困惑度逼近 AR
2406.07524.tldr_en: Simplifies masked diffusion ELBO to weighted MLM cross-entropy, closing the perplexity gap to AR

2406.08938.title: Mirror and Preconditioned Gradient Descent in Wasserstein Space
2406.08938.tldr_zh: 把镜像下降和预条件梯度下降提升到 Wasserstein 空间，给出相对光滑/凸条件下的收敛保证，并在病态目标与单细胞对齐上验证
2406.08938.tldr_en: Lifts mirror descent and preconditioned GD to Wasserstein space with convergence guarantees under relative smoothness/convexity, validated on ill-conditioned objectives and single-cell alignment

2406.09570.title: Improving Consistency Models with Generator-Augmented Flows
2406.09570.tldr_zh: 证明 CT 与 CD 差异在连续时间不消失；用一致性模型预测端点与同一噪声重配对（GC）降低该差异与传输成本，CIFAR-10 FID 7.42→5.95。
2406.09570.tldr_en: Proves the CT-CD gap persists in continuous time (regularizer R depends on velocity-estimator misalignment); generator-augmented coupling re-pairs predicted endpoints with the same noise, lowering R and transport cost, FID 7.42 to 5.95 on CIFAR-10.

2406.12303.title: Immiscible Diffusion: Accelerating Diffusion Training with Noise Assignment
2406.12303.tldr_zh: batch 内就近分配噪声给图像，训练加速最高 3×，开销 22.8ms/1024 batch
2406.12303.tldr_en: Batch-wise nearest noise assignment accelerates diffusion training up to 3x with negligible overhead

2406.12616.title: Learning diffusion at lightspeed
2406.12616.tldr_zh: JKOnet*：用 JKO 步一阶最优性条件替代双层优化，单层二次损失同时学 potential/interaction/internal 能量，线性参数化有闭式解
2406.12616.tldr_en: JKOnet* replaces the bilevel JKO inverse problem by a quadratic loss on the JKO first-order optimality condition, learning potential, interaction and internal energies with a closed form for linear features.

2406.14426.title: Transferable Boltzmann Generators
2406.14426.tldr_zh: 等变 CNF+flow matching 训练首个跨二肽零样本 Boltzmann Generator，拓扑嵌入是关键
2406.14426.tldr_en: First transferable Boltzmann Generator via equivariant CNF+FM, zero-shot on dipeptides; topology embeddings key

2406.18009.title: E2 TTS: Embarrassingly Easy Fully Non-Autoregressive Zero-Shot TTS
2406.18009.tldr_zh: 字符序列补 filler token 对齐 mel 长度后直接 FM infilling，砍掉时长模型/G2P/单调对齐，仍达人类级自然度
2406.18009.tldr_en: Character sequence with filler tokens aligned to mel length, trained via FM infilling; no duration model, G2P, or monotonic alignment, yet human-level naturalness

2407.10181.title: Multiscale Sliced Wasserstein Distances as Perceptual Color Difference Measures
2407.10181.tldr_zh: 多尺度 SWD 在 CIELAB 空间做 training-free 感知色差度量，对错位图像对稳健，可当颜色迁移损失
2407.10181.tldr_en: Multiscale sliced Wasserstein distance in CIELAB as a training-free perceptual color difference measure robust to misalignment

2407.12718.title: SlimFlow: Training Smaller One-Step Diffusion Models with Rectified Flow
2407.12718.tldr_zh: Annealing Reflow 在独立耦合与教师耦合间退火解决小学生初始化失配，两步 Euler 在线正则蒸馏；15.7M 参数一步 CIFAR-10 FID 5.02
2407.12718.tldr_en: Annealing Reflow interpolates from independent to teacher couplings to warm-start small students; flow-guided two-step regularizer improves distillation; 15.7M-param one-step CIFAR-10 FID 5.02.

2407.15595.title: Discrete Flow Matching
2407.15595.tldr_zh: 离散流匹配：通用概率路径族+后验参数化速度公式，1.7B 模型代码生成 Pass@1 6.7%
2407.15595.tldr_en: Discrete flow matching with general probability paths and posterior-parameterized velocities; 1.7B model reaches 6.7% Pass@1 on HumanEval

2407.16074.title: Schrödinger Bridge for Generative Speech Enhancement
2407.16074.tldr_zh: 配对 SB 做复数 STFT 域语音增强，去噪 WER 相对降 20%、去混响降 6%，比扩散基线省算力
2407.16074.tldr_en: Paired Schrödinger bridge in complex STFT domain for SE; 20% relative WER reduction on denoising, 6% on dereverberation

2407.18163.title: Statistical Optimal Transport
2407.18163.tldr_zh: 统计侧系统讲义；第 1 章是最紧凑的严格预备（Brenier、循环单调、对偶三合一），其余归 T06/T05
2407.18163.tldr_en: Saint-Flour lecture notes on statistical OT: Chapter 1 is a compact rigorous primer (Brenier via cyclical monotonicity, duality); Chapters 2-8 cover rates and Wasserstein geometry.

2407.19689.title: PDOT: a Practical Primal-Dual Algorithm and a GPU-Based Solver for Optimal Transport
2407.19689.tldr_zh: restarted PDHG 做 matrix-free 精确 OT，GPU 上高精度区间作者报告快于 Sinkhorn 且更稳
2407.19689.tldr_en: Restarted PDHG with matrix-free OT structure; GPU solver reports high-accuracy wins over Sinkhorn

2407.20444.title: Importance Corrected Neural JKO Sampling
2407.20444.tldr_zh: CNF 做 JKO 局部步 + 重要性拒绝重采样非局部步，修正多峰质量错配，可产 iid 样本并评估密度
2407.20444.tldr_en: CNF-based JKO local steps plus importance rejection resampling correct multimodal mass mismatch, yielding iid samples and density evaluation

2408.08822.title: PFDiff: Training-Free Acceleration of Diffusion Models Combining Past and Future Scores
2408.08822.tldr_zh: 零训练跳步：复用过去 score 得跳板，跳板处 score 做前瞻更新；guided ImageNet-64 DDIM 4 NFE 138.81→16.46
2408.08822.tldr_en: Training-free timestep skipping: past score predicts a springboard, future score there drives a Nesterov-style leap; guided ImageNet-64 DDIM 4-NFE FID 138.81 to 16.46.

2408.09000.title: Classifier-Free Guidance is a Predictor-Corrector
2408.09000.tldr_zh: CFG 不采样 gamma-powered 分布；SDE 极限下等价于条件 DDIM 预测加 gamma-powered Langevin 校正
2408.09000.tldr_en: CFG is not gamma-powered sampling; in SDE limit it equals conditional DDIM predictor plus gamma-powered Langevin corrector

2408.14608.title: Meta Flow Matching: Integrating Vector Fields on the Wasserstein Manifold
2408.14608.tldr_zh: 用 GNN 嵌入初始群体，amortize Flow Matching 速度场，泛化到未见病人的治疗响应预测
2408.14608.tldr_en: GNN-embedded initial populations amortize Flow Matching vector fields, generalizing to unseen patients

2409.08861.title: Adjoint Matching: Fine-tuning Flow and Diffusion Generative Models with Memoryless Stochastic Optimal Control
2409.08861.tldr_zh: reward 微调必须用 memoryless 噪声调度 σ(t)=√(2η_t) 消除初值偏差；Adjoint Matching 是无 importance weighting 的最小二乘 SOC 回归
2409.08861.tldr_en: Memoryless noise schedule σ(t)=√(2η_t) is necessary for unbiased reward fine-tuning; Adjoint Matching solves SOC via least-squares regression without importance weighting

2409.09376.title: BM²: Coupled Schrödinger Bridge Matching
2409.09376.tldr_zh: 前后向漂移互为 bridge-matching 目标、单网络单循环 SGD 求 SB；完全极小化时等价 I-BM/DIPF，部分极小化只证不动点
2409.09376.tldr_en: Forward and backward drifts regress on each other's bridge mixtures in one SGD loop; full minimization recovers I-BM/DIPF, partial minimization only has SB as fixed point.

2409.13074.title: What does guidance do? A fine-grained analysis in a simple setting
2409.13074.tldr_zh: 严格证明 guidance 不采样 tilted 分布；w 增大时样本堆向条件支撑集边界，score 有误差时逸出支撑集
2409.13074.tldr_en: Proves guidance does not sample tilted distribution; samples concentrate at support boundary as w grows, escape support under score error

2409.17917.title: WaSt-3D: Wasserstein-2 Distance for Scene-to-Scene Stylization on 3D Gaussians
2409.17917.tldr_zh: 用熵正则 W2/Sinkhorn 散度匹配 3D 高斯分布，training-free 场景级 3DGS 风格迁移
2409.17917.tldr_en: Training-free 3DGS scene stylization via entropy-regularized W2 matching of Gaussian distributions

2409.18959.title: O(d/T) Convergence Theory for Diffusion Probabilistic Models under Minimal Assumptions
2409.18959.tldr_zh: 一阶矩有限+ℓ2 score 下 DDPM 的 TV≲d log³T/T+ε_score√logT；换后验方差系数后 d 变内在维数 k
2409.18959.tldr_en: DDPM attains TV rate d/T (k/T with intrinsic dimension k) under finite first moment and L2-accurate scores, bypassing the KL/Girsanov barrier.

2410.00844.title: Learning stochastic dynamics from snapshots through regularized unbalanced optimal transport
2410.00844.tldr_zh: DeepRUOT 用 Fisher 正则把 RUOT 的 SDE 约束化成 ODE，无先验同时学增殖率与转移动力学，消除假转移并重建 Waddington 景观
2410.00844.tldr_en: DeepRUOT solves regularized unbalanced OT via Fisher regularization, turning SDE constraints into ODEs to jointly learn growth and transport from snapshots

2410.02490.title: Stochastic variance-reduced Gaussian variational inference on the Bures-Wasserstein manifold
2410.02490.tldr_zh: BW 流形高斯 VI 加 Stein score 控制变量，方差降、KL 精度提升多个数量级
2410.02490.tldr_en: Control variate using Stein score reduces variance of BW Gaussian VI gradients, improving KL by orders of magnitude

2410.02671.title: Unpaired Point Cloud Completion through Unbalanced Optimal Transport
2410.02671.tldr_zh: 把无配对补全形式化为 UOT map 学习，InfoCD 作 cost，类别失衡下更稳
2410.02671.tldr_en: Formulates unpaired completion as UOT map learning with InfoCD cost; robust under class imbalance

2410.03783.title: Improving Neural Optimal Transport via Displacement Interpolation
2410.03783.tldr_zh: 用 displacement interpolation 全轨迹与 HJB 正则稳定神经 OT max-min 训练，I2I 翻译 FID 改善
2410.03783.tldr_en: Stabilizes neural OT max-min via full displacement interpolation trajectory and HJB regularization; improves I2I FID

2410.05954.title: Pyramidal Flow Matching for Efficient Video Generative Modeling
2410.05954.tldr_zh: 空间金字塔分段流+时间金字塔压缩历史，单一 DiT 端到端训出 768p·24fps·10s 视频
2410.05954.tldr_en: Spatial pyramid piecewise flow + temporal pyramid history compression in a single end-to-end DiT

2410.07761.title: $\textit{Jump Your Steps}$: Optimizing Sampling Schedule of Discrete Diffusion Models
2410.07761.tldr_zh: JYS 在固定 NFE 下优化离散扩散采样时间表，最小化并行采样复合解码误差上界，无需额外计算
2410.07761.tldr_en: JYS optimizes discrete diffusion sampling schedules under fixed NFE by minimizing an upper bound on compounding decoding error

2410.08709.title: Distillation of Discrete Diffusion through Dimensional Correlations
2410.08709.tldr_zh: 用混合模型显式学维度相关性，把多步独立分解的教师蒸馏成 few-step 学生，并给出学生-教师分布距离上界
2410.08709.tldr_en: Mixture models capture dimensional correlations to distill multi-step product teachers into few-step students, with TV distance upper bounds

2410.09046.title: Linear Convergence of Diffusion Models Under the Manifold Hypothesis
2410.09046.tldr_zh: d 维流形数据上，DDPM 系数（冻结后验均值）反向 SDE 达 KL-ε² 只需 Õ(d/ε²) 步，对内在维数线性且 sharp；指数积分器必付 D 代价
2410.09046.tldr_en: On d-dimensional manifold data, the DDPM discretization (freezing E[X0|Xt]) reaches ε²-KL in Õ(d/ε²) steps—linear in intrinsic dimension and sharp—while exponential integrators pay for ambient D.

2410.12557.title: One Step Diffusion via Shortcut Models
2410.12557.tldr_zh: 步长 d 作为条件输入，自蒸馏只需 log2(T) 次 bootstrap；单网络单阶段支持任意步数预算
2410.12557.tldr_en: Condition on step size d; self-distillation needs only log2(T) bootstraps; single network supports any step budget

2410.13431.title: Solving Prior Distribution Mismatch in Diffusion Models via Optimal Transport
2410.13431.tldr_zh: 半离散 OT（几何变分 Brenier 势）把 N(0,I) 一步映到前向终态消 prior error，再短程扩散；作者报告 CIFAR-10 FID 1.31@50NFE
2410.13431.tldr_en: Semi-discrete OT map (geometric-variational Brenier potential) sends N(0,I) onto the forward terminal law to kill prior error, then short diffusion; authors report CIFAR-10 FID 1.31 at 50 NFE.

2410.14949.title: On the Convergence and Straightness of Rectified Flow
2410.14949.tldr_zh: W2² 离散误差 ≤ C·γ_{2,T}/T²；1-RF 直的充分条件（Jacobian 半正定）与 Monge 最优条件（Jacobian 可交换）
2410.14949.tldr_en: Piecewise straightness gamma_{2,T} bounds Euler W2 error as O(gamma/T^2); sufficient Jacobian conditions make 1-RF straight or even the Monge map.

2410.15371.title: FrameBridge: Improving Image-to-Video Generation with Bridge Models
2410.15371.tldr_zh: 把 I2V 从噪声到数据改为图像到视频的桥过程，零样本 FVD 从 192 降到 95
2410.15371.tldr_en: Reformulates I2V as a data-to-data bridge process, reducing zero-shot FVD from 192 to 95

2410.20478.title: MusicFlow: Cascaded Flow Matching for Text Guided Music Generation
2410.20478.tldr_zh: 级联双 FM（文本→HuBERT 语义→Encodec 声学）+ masked 预测，参数小 2-5 倍、步数少 5 倍，零样本续写/填充
2410.20478.tldr_en: Cascaded dual flow matching (text→semantic→acoustic) with masked prediction; 2-5x smaller, 5x fewer steps, zero-shot infilling

2410.20587.title: Generator Matching: Generative modeling with arbitrary Markov processes
2410.20587.tldr_zh: 用 Markov 生成元统一 FM/diffusion/离散 diffusion，R^d 上生成元=flow+diffusion+jump 完全刻画，Bregman 散度是唯一合法损失；jump+flow 叠加 CIFAR-10 FID 2.36
2410.20587.tldr_en: Unifies FM, diffusion and discrete diffusion via Markov generators; fully characterizes R^d generators as flow+diffusion+jump; Bregman divergences are the only valid losses; jump+flow superposition reaches CIFAR-10 FID 2.36.

2410.21035.title: Beyond Autoregression: Fast LLMs via Self-Distillation Through Time
2410.21035.tldr_zh: 跨时间自蒸馏把 masked 扩散 LM 采样步数压到 16–32 步，生成质量仍超 GPT-2 级 AR
2410.21035.tldr_en: Self-distillation through time cuts masked diffusion LM sampling to 16-32 steps while beating GPT-2-level AR quality

2410.22388.title: ET-Flow: Equivariant Flow-Matching for Molecular Conformer Generation
2410.22388.tldr_zh: 等变Transformer+flow matching+harmonic prior+Kabsch对齐，8.3M参数在GEOM-DRUGS精度超242M的MCF-L，5步采样仍SOTA
2410.22388.tldr_en: Equivariant transformer flow matching with harmonic prior and Kabsch alignment achieves SOTA conformer precision with 8.3M params

2410.22637.title: Consistency Diffusion Bridge Models
2410.22637.tldr_zh: 学DDBM PF-ODE一致性函数，2 NFE达其百步质量，加速4–50×
2410.22637.tldr_en: Learns the consistency function of DDBM's PF-ODE via distillation or fine-tuning; 2 NFE matches DDBM at ~100 NFE, 4-50x faster.

2410.23405.title: FlowLLM: Flow Matching for Material Generation with Large Language Models as Base Distributions
2410.23405.tldr_zh: 微调 LLM 输出作 RFM 的 base，稳定率 4.65%→17.82%，S.U.N. 率 3.34%→4.92%
2410.23405.tldr_en: LLM output as RFM base distribution lifts stability rate from 4.65% to 17.82% on MP-20

2411.00322.title: Constant Acceleration Flow
2411.00322.tldr_zh: 常加速度二次轨迹 + 初速度条件化消除路径交叉歧义；CIFAR-10 一步 FID 4.81（+GAN 1.39），耦合保持 PSNR 46.68 vs RF 33.34
2411.00322.tldr_en: Constant-acceleration ODE with initial-velocity conditioning resolves flow crossing; one-step CIFAR-10 FID 4.81 (1.39 with GAN), ImageNet-64 1.69 with GAN, far better coupling preservation than rectified flow.

2411.00698.title: Wasserstein Flow Matching: Generative Modeling Over Families of Distributions
2411.00698.tldr_zh: 把 FM 提升到 Wasserstein 空间，样本本身是分布，Gaussian 用闭式 BW 路径、点云用 entropic OT 估计
2411.00698.tldr_en: Lifts flow matching to Wasserstein space over distributions, using closed-form Bures-Wasserstein paths for Gaussians and entropic OT for point clouds

2411.00759.title: Minibatch Optimal Transport and Perplexity Bound Estimation in Discrete Flow Matching
2411.00759.tldr_zh: 离散 flow matching 引入 minibatch OT 耦合，推理步数最多降 32 倍且不损多样性
2411.00759.tldr_en: Minibatch OT in discrete flow matching cuts inference steps up to 32x without diversity loss

2411.04746.title: Taming Rectified Flow for Inversion and Editing
2411.04746.tldr_zh: 免训练高阶求解器降低 rectified flow ODE 反演误差，配合特征共享在 FLUX/OpenSora 上改进图像与视频编辑
2411.04746.tldr_en: Training-free high-order solver reduces rectified flow ODE inversion error; feature sharing enables image/video editing on FLUX and OpenSora

2411.05007.title: SVDQuant: Absorbing Outliers by Low-Rank Components for 4-Bit Diffusion Models
2411.05007.tldr_zh: SVDQuant 用低秩分支吸收离群值实现 W4A4 量化，FLUX.1 在笔记本 4090 上比 W4A16 快 3 倍
2411.05007.tldr_en: SVDQuant absorbs outliers via low-rank branch for W4A4 diffusion quantization, 3x faster than W4A16 on laptop 4090

2411.09502.title: Golden Noise for Diffusion Models: A Learning Framework
2411.09502.tldr_zh: 10 万对反演噪声训练 NPNet，一次前传把随机噪声变黄金噪声；SDXL ImageReward 58.01→65.01
2411.09502.tldr_en: NPNet learns random-to-golden noise mapping from 100k re-denoise inversion pairs; plug-and-play, +0.4s, ImageReward 58.01 to 65.01 on SDXL.

2411.10555.title: Low-Rank Optimal Transport through Factor Relaxation with Latent Coupling
2411.10555.tldr_zh: LC 因子化解耦低秩 OT 为三个子 OT，坐标镜像下降统一 W/GW/FGW 与均衡/非均衡/半松弛
2411.10555.tldr_en: Latent coupling factorization decouples low-rank OT into three sub-OT problems solved by coordinate mirror descent

2411.16443.title: SplatFlow: Multi-View Rectified Flow Model for 3D Gaussian Splatting Synthesis
2411.16443.tldr_zh: 多视角 rectified flow 联合生成图像/深度/位姿 latent，前馈 GSDecoder 输出 3DGS，training-free 反演/补绘统一生成与编辑
2411.16443.tldr_en: Multi-view rectified flow jointly generates image/depth/pose latents, decoded to 3DGS by feed-forward GSDecoder; training-free inversion/inpainting unifies generation and editing

2412.02214.title: GIST: Towards Photorealistic Style Transfer via Multiscale Geometric Representations
2412.02214.tldr_zh: 小波/Contourlet 子带上高斯闭式 W2 匹配做免训练照片级风格迁移，推理 0.1s
2412.02214.tldr_en: Training-free photorealistic style transfer via Gaussian closed-form W2 matching on wavelet/contourlet subbands

2412.03895.title: A Noise is Worth Diffusion Guidance
2412.03895.tldr_zh: LoRA 噪声精炼器把高斯噪声映到免引导噪声空间，SD2.1 无 CFG 达 CFG 质量，FID 11.39 vs 13.38，约 2× 快
2412.03895.tldr_en: NoiseRefine learns a one-shot noise-to-guidance-free-noise map via multistep score distillation; SD2.1 without CFG matches CFG quality at 2x speed.

2412.04724.title: StableVC: Style Controllable Zero-Shot Voice Conversion with Conditional Flow Matching
2412.04724.tldr_zh: 解耦内容/音色/风格，OT-CFM 重建 mel，音色与风格可独立迁移到不同 unseen 说话人，10 步采样 RTF 0.146
2412.04724.tldr_en: Disentangles content/timbre/style and uses OT-CFM to independently transfer timbre and style to different unseen speakers, 10-step sampling RTF 0.146

2412.05101.title: The Silent Assistant: NoiseQuery as Implicit Guidance for Goal-Driven Image Generation
2412.05101.tldr_zh: 无条件生成后验给 10 万噪声建特征库，推理 0.002 s 查库选初值；免训练、跨模型复用，偏好分小幅一致提升
2412.05101.tldr_en: Offline noise library keyed by unconditional-generation features; 0.002 s retrieval picks prompt-aligned initial noise, model-agnostic, small consistent gains.

2412.06264.title: Flow Matching Guide and Code
2412.06264.tldr_zh: 官方综述+PyTorch库，统一连续/离散/流形/Generator Matching记号与训练实践
2412.06264.tldr_en: Official tutorial and PyTorch library unifying FM notation across continuous, discrete, manifold, and generator matching

2412.07772.title: From Slow Bidirectional to Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion Models
2412.07772.tldr_zh: 双向教师非对称蒸馏为4步因果学生，KV缓存流式9.4 FPS，VBench-Long 84.27
2412.07772.tldr_en: Asymmetric DMD distillation from bidirectional teacher to 4-step causal student enables 9.4 FPS streaming video generation

2412.10117.title: CosyVoice 2: Scalable Streaming Speech Synthesis with Large Language Models
2412.10117.tldr_zh: FSQ 替换 VQ、预训练 LLM 做骨干、chunk-aware 因果 FM，单模型统一流式/非流式 TTS，流式近乎无损
2412.10117.tldr_en: FSQ tokenizer, pretrained LLM backbone, chunk-aware causal FM unify streaming and non-streaming TTS with near-lossless streaming quality

2412.10966.title: FlowDock: Geometric Flow Matching for Generative Protein-Ligand Docking and Affinity Prediction
2412.10966.tldr_zh: CFM 直接 apo→holo 多配体对接并预测亲和力，盲对接超单序列 AF3
2412.10966.tldr_en: CFM maps apo to holo multi-ligand docking with affinity prediction, beating single-sequence AF3

2412.14528.title: Multi-Level Optimal Transport for Universal Cross-Tokenizer Knowledge Distillation on Language Models
2412.14528.tldr_zh: 双层 OT（token 级排序截断 + 序列级 Sinkhorn）对齐不同词表 logit，跨 tokenizer 蒸馏优于 ULD
2412.14528.tldr_en: Dual-level OT (token-level ranking/truncation + sequence-level Sinkhorn) aligns logits across tokenizers, outperforming ULD in CTKD

2501.00103.title: LTX-Video: Realtime Video Latent Diffusion
2501.00103.tldr_zh: 1:192 高压缩 Video-VAE 与去噪 transformer 协同设计，H100 上 2 秒生成 5 秒 768×512 视频
2501.00103.tldr_en: 1:192 compression Video-VAE with denoising decoder, 2s for 5s 768×512 video on H100

2501.07897.title: Bridge-SR: Schrödinger Bridge for Efficient SR
2501.07897.tldr_zh: 波形域语音超分：低分辨率波形作先验的可解 SB，1.7M 参数 4 步胜过 8 步条件扩散
2501.07897.tldr_en: Waveform-domain speech SR via tractable SB with LR waveform as prior; 4-step beats 8-step conditional diffusion at 1.7M params

2501.08316.title: Diffusion Adversarial Post-Training for One-Step Video Generation
2501.08316.tldr_zh: 扩散预训练后对真实数据做对抗后训练，单步生成 2 秒 720p 24fps 视频，视觉保真度超 25 步教师
