2501.08316.tldr_en: Adversarial post-training on real data after diffusion pre-training enables one-step 720p 24fps video generation with visual fidelity surpassing the 25-step teacher

2501.08331.title: Go-with-the-Flow: Motion-Controllable Video Diffusion Models Using Real-Time Warped Noise
2501.08331.tldr_zh: 实时噪声 warp 算法把光流编码进初始噪声，零架构改动实现视频运动控制
2501.08331.tldr_en: Real-time noise warping encodes optical flow into initial noise for motion-controllable video diffusion without architecture changes

2501.11311.title: Audio-to-Audio Schrödinger Bridges
2501.11311.tldr_zh: 单一 SB 模型统一 44.1kHz 音乐带宽扩展与 inpainting，免声码器端到端，可修复小时级长音频
2501.11311.tldr_en: Single SB model for 44.1kHz music bandwidth extension and inpainting, vocoder-free end-to-end, hour-long audio

2501.14171.title: Fully Guided Neural Schrödinger Bridge for Brain MR Image Synthesis
2501.14171.tldr_zh: UNSB 改配对：源图全程条件 + L1/patchNCE/互信息正则 + 病灶 mask 加权损失，NFE=5，作者报告 5 个脑 MRI 数据集像素与 WMH Dice 多为最优
2501.14171.tldr_en: Paired UNSB variant with full source guidance, MI regularizer and lesion-mask weighted losses; NFE=5; authors report best PSNR and WMH segmentation Dice on most of five brain MRI datasets.

2502.02150.title: On the Guidance of Flow Matching
2502.02150.tldr_zh: 首个通用 FM 引导框架：免训练渐近精确引导、训练式引导损失，覆盖 DPS/LGD/ΠGDM 为特例
2502.02150.tldr_en: First general flow matching guidance framework with training-free asymptotically exact guidance and training-based losses

2502.02582.title: Open Materials Generation with Stochastic Interpolants
2502.02582.tldr_zh: 用 stochastic interpolants 统一扩散与流匹配，按自由度调插值，CSP/DNG 超 FlowMM/DiffCSP/MatterGen
2502.02582.tldr_en: Unifies diffusion and flow matching via stochastic interpolants with per-degree-of-freedom tuning, outperforming FlowMM/DiffCSP/MatterGen on CSP and DNG

2502.06061.title: Online Reward-Weighted Fine-Tuning of Flow Matching with Wasserstein Regularization
2502.06061.tldr_zh: reward 加权 CFM 在线微调 flow 模型，W2 上界正则防坍缩，给出收敛极限与可控权衡
2502.06061.tldr_en: Online reward-weighted CFM fine-tuning with W2 upper-bound regularization prevents policy collapse and enables reward-diversity trade-off

2502.06608.title: TripoSG: High-Fidelity 3D Shape Synthesis using Large-Scale Rectified Flow Models
2502.06608.tldr_zh: 1.5B/4B rectified flow transformer + SDF-VAE，2M 数据上图生 3D，作者报告 SOTA
2502.06608.tldr_en: Large-scale rectified flow transformer with SDF-VAE for image-to-3D, trained on 2M samples

2502.09992.title: Large Language Diffusion Models
2502.09992.tldr_zh: 8B 从零预训练+SFT 的 masked 扩散 LM，多基准比肩 LLaMA3-8B，并破解 reversal curse
2502.09992.tldr_en: 8B masked diffusion LM trained from scratch matches LLaMA3-8B on benchmarks and breaks the reversal curse

2502.11778.title: Private Synthetic Graph Generation and Fused Gromov-Wasserstein Distance
2502.11778.tldr_zh: 用 TV-PSMM 生成顶点级 ε-DP 属性图，FGW 距离给出 O((εn)^(-1/(d+1))) 精度上界
2502.11778.tldr_en: Vertex-level ε-DP attributed graph generation via TV-PSMM, with FGW-based utility bounds of O((εn)^(-1/(d+1)))

2502.12456.title: Not-So-Optimal Transport Flows for 3D Point Cloud Generation
2502.12456.tldr_zh: 证明 equivariant OT 在大点云上算不动且完全 OT 耦合让 t≈0 处场难学，提出离线 superset OT + 混合耦合，少步数生成优于基线
2502.12456.tldr_en: Shows equivariant OT scales poorly on large point clouds and full OT coupling makes t≈0 vector field hard to learn; proposes offline superset OT + hybrid coupling for few-step generation

2502.17436.title: Towards Hierarchical Rectified Flow
2502.17436.tldr_zh: 速度空间再做一层 RF（学加速度）建模多模态速度分布，采样路径可相交更直；CIFAR-10 5 NFE FID 30.9 vs RF 36.2，位置层仅 1–2 步
2502.17436.tldr_en: Hierarchical rectified flow learns the full multimodal velocity distribution via a second RF in velocity space; intersecting, straighter paths give lower FID at equal total NFE on MNIST/CIFAR-10.

2503.00266.title: Flow Matching for Medical Image Synthesis: Bridging the Gap Between Speed and Quality
2503.00266.tldr_zh: 直线路径 FM（独立耦合，无 minibatch OT）做超声/3D 脑 MRI 生成，10 步 FID 与下游分割 Dice 超 50 步 DDPM；生成而非模态转换
2503.00266.tldr_en: Straight-path flow matching (independent coupling, no minibatch OT) for ultrasound and 3D brain MRI synthesis; 10-step MOTFM beats 50-step DDPM on FID and downstream segmentation Dice.

2503.00710.title: Proteina: Scaling Flow-based Protein Structure Generative Models
2503.00710.tldr_zh: 非等变大 transformer + 层级 fold 条件 + autoguidance，蛋白骨架流模型达 800 残基、99% 可设计
2503.00710.tldr_en: Scales Cα-coordinate rectified flow with non-equivariant transformer, hierarchical fold conditioning, and autoguidance to 800-residue designable backbones

2503.02819.title: Feynman-Kac Correctors in Diffusion: Annealing, Guidance, and Product of Experts
2503.02819.tldr_zh: 用 Feynman-Kac 权重+SMC 重采样修正扩散推理，精确采样退火/几何平均/乘积分布
2503.02819.tldr_en: Feynman-Kac weights plus SMC resampling correct diffusion inference to exactly sample annealed, geometric-averaged, and product distributions

2503.03025.title: Hierarchical Refinement: Optimal Transport to Infinity and Beyond
2503.03025.tldr_zh: 低秩 OT 因子与 Monge map 共聚类，递归细化出全秩双射，百万点规模跑通
2503.03025.tldr_en: Low-rank OT factors co-cluster Monge pairs; recursive refinement yields full-rank bijection at million-point scale

2503.06674.title: Learning Few-Step Diffusion Models by Trajectory Distribution Matching
2503.06674.tldr_zh: TDM 用数据自由的轨迹分布匹配蒸馏，4 步生成在 SDXL/PixArt-α/CogVideoX-2B 上超过教师
2503.06674.tldr_en: Data-free trajectory distribution matching distills 4-step generators surpassing teachers on SDXL, PixArt-α, CogVideoX-2B

2503.07535.title: LBM: Latent Bridge Matching for Fast Image-to-Image Translation
2503.07535.tldr_zh: latent桥匹配蒸馏到单步，覆盖去物体/深度/重光照，作者称SOTA
2503.07535.tldr_en: Bridge matching in VAE latent space enables single-step I2I (object removal, depth/normal, relighting, shadows); authors claim SOTA.

2503.09573.title: Block Diffusion: Interpolating Between Autoregressive and Diffusion Language Models
2503.09573.tldr_zh: 块间自回归+块内 masked 扩散，支持 KV cache 与任意长度生成，扩散 LM 似然新 SOTA
2503.09573.tldr_en: Block-wise AR over masked diffusion blocks; enables KV cache and arbitrary-length generation; new diffusion LM likelihood SOTA

2503.09583.title: Minimax Optimality of the Probability Flow ODE for Diffusion Models
2503.09583.tldr_zh: 次高斯+β-Hölder(β≤2) 密度下，软阈值高斯核 score 估计器+PF-ODE 采样器 TV 误差 Õ(n^{-β/(d+2β)})，确定性采样器首次（近）minimax（预印本）
2503.09583.tldr_en: Preprint: a soft-thresholded Gaussian-kernel score estimator controlling both L2 and Jacobian error makes the PF-ODE sampler near-minimax in TV, rate n^{-β/(d+2β)}, for subgaussian β-Hölder (β≤2) targets.

2503.10636.title: The Curse of Conditions: Analyzing and Improving Optimal Transport for Conditional Flow-Based Generation
2503.10636.tldr_zh: 无条件 minibatch OT 在条件生成中系统性有害（训练先验被条件偏斜），成本矩阵加条件项即修复。
2503.10636.tldr_en: Minibatch OT coupling skews the training prior conditionally and hurts conditional FM; C2OT adds a condition-aware cost term to restore x0-c independence.

2503.14975.title: Taming Flow Matching with Unbalanced Optimal Transport into Fast Pansharpening
2503.14975.tldr_zh: UOT 对偶 + 任务正则把 FM 变成一步 pansharpening，性能追平 25 步扩散模型
2503.14975.tldr_en: UOT dual + task regularization turns FM into one-step pansharpening, matching 25-step diffusion

2503.19034.title: Color Conditional Generation with Sliced Wasserstein Guidance
2503.19034.tldr_zh: 把可微 Sliced-1-Wasserstein 色彩距离注入扩散采样循环，training-free 实现颜色条件生成，色彩匹配优于先迁移流水线
2503.19034.tldr_en: Injects differentiable Sliced-1-Wasserstein color distance into diffusion sampling for training-free color-conditional generation

2503.19062.title: Color Transfer with Modulated Flows
2503.19062.tldr_zh: 用 rectified flow 学 RGB 到均匀立方体的双射，编码器预测流权重，零微调泛化颜色迁移
2503.19062.tldr_en: Rectified flows map RGB to a uniform cube; an encoder predicts flow weights for zero-finetune color transfer

2503.21774.title: Optimal Stepsize for Diffusion Sampling
2503.21774.tldr_zh: 步长调度=学生 M 步逼近教师端点的 DP 搜索（最优子结构）；Flux 10 步保留 GenEval 99.4%
2503.21774.tldr_en: Casts stepsize scheduling as DP over teacher-trajectory subsets via optimal substructure; Flux 10 steps keep 99.4% of GenEval.

2503.22168.title: Spatial Transport Optimization by Repositioning Attention Map for Training-Free Text-to-Image Synthesis
2503.22168.tldr_zh: STORM 用带空间方向代价的 OT 在早期去噪步重定位 attention map，免训练纠正物体错位
2503.22168.tldr_en: STORM repositions cross-attention maps via spatial-cost OT in early denoising steps, training-free

2503.22984.title: Optimal Transport-Guided Source-Free Adaptation for Face Anti-Spoofing
2503.22984.tldr_zh: OT 搬运源原型到目标域，免参或轻量适配活体检测，跨域 HTER 平均 2.91%
2503.22984.tldr_en: OT shifts source prototypes to target domain for training-free or lightweight FAS adaptation, avg HTER 2.91%

2503.24129.title: It's a (Blind) Match! Towards Vision-Language Correspondence without Parallel Data
2503.24129.tldr_zh: 把无平行数据的视觉-语言匹配写成 QAP，提出 factorized Hahn-Grant 求解器，实证基础模型嵌入可无监督结构对齐
2503.24129.tldr_en: Formulates blind vision-language matching as a QAP, proposes a factorized Hahn-Grant solver, and empirically shows unsupervised structural alignment of foundation model embeddings

2504.03072.title: How I Warped Your Noise: a Temporally-Correlated Noise Prior for Diffusion Models
2504.03072.tldr_zh: ∫-noise 把离散噪声视为白噪声积分，噪声传输方程沿光流保分布 warp，帧间相关且逐帧 i.i.d. 高斯；warp 误差 10.00→2.50，约 1 s/帧
2504.03072.tldr_en: Integral-noise reinterprets pixels as white-noise integrals; a noise transport equation warps noise along optical flow preserving per-frame Gaussianity while correlating frames.

2504.03188.title: Pairwise Optimal Transports for Training All-to-All Flow-Based Condition Transfer Model
2504.03188.tldr_zh: 用双条件惩罚的 minibatch OT 耦合同时学所有条件对之间的 pairwise OT，支持连续条件与非分组数据
2504.03188.tldr_en: Learns pairwise OT across all condition pairs via a dual-condition-penalized minibatch OT coupling, supporting continuous conditions and non-grouped data

2505.03114.title: Path and Bone-Contour Regularized Unpaired MRI-to-CT Translation
2505.03114.tldr_zh: 无配对 MRI→CT：共享潜空间 θ 连续生成器 + 逐层 Jacobian 路径长度正则 + 可训练骨轮廓正则，三数据集 PSNR/SSIM 最优，骨 Dice 0.84 vs 0.81
2505.03114.tldr_en: Unpaired MRI-to-CT via shared latent space, theta-conditioned generator with layer-wise Jacobian path-length regularization and a learned bone-contour loss; best PSNR/SSIM on three datasets, bone Dice 0.84 vs 0.81.

2505.06589.title: Optimal Transport for Machine Learners
2505.06589.tldr_zh: 面向 ML 的 OT 全景教材，16 章从点云匹配到 flow matching/transformer，本课题首推入门书
2505.06589.tldr_en: 480-page ML-oriented OT textbook: Monge/Kantorovich, Brenier, Sinkhorn, gradient flows, flow matching and transformers, with POT-based code.

2505.11197.title: Modeling Cell Dynamics and Interactions with Unbalanced Mean Field Schrödinger Bridge
2505.11197.tldr_zh: UMFSB 框架把细胞交互项加入 unbalanced SB，CytoBridge 四网络从快照学速度/增长/密度/交互势，合成与 scRNA-seq 上 W1、TMV 优于 DeepRUOT 等基线
2505.11197.tldr_en: UMFSB adds cell-cell interaction to unbalanced SB; CytoBridge learns velocity, growth, density, interaction potential from snapshots, beating DeepRUOT on W1/TMV

2505.11823.title: Variational Regularized Unbalanced Optimal Transport: Single Network, Least Action
2505.11823.tldr_zh: 把 RUOT 一阶最优性条件嵌入参数化与损失，单标量场求解，作用量更低、训练更快更稳
2505.11823.tldr_en: Embeds RUOT first-order optimality conditions into parameterization and loss; single scalar field solves RUOT with lower action and faster, more stable training

2505.13447.title: Mean Flows for One-step Generative Modeling
2505.13447.tldr_zh: 用平均速度场替代瞬时速度，MeanFlow identity 从头训练一步生成，ImageNet-256 1-NFE FID 3.43
2505.13447.tldr_en: MeanFlow models average velocity fields via a derived identity, enabling from-scratch 1-NFE generation with ImageNet-256 FID 3.43

2505.13660.title: Sobolev Gradient Ascent for Optimal Transport: Barycenter Optimization and Convergence Analysis
2505.13660.tldr_zh: 无约束凹对偶+Sobolev梯度上升算精确barycenter，免c-concave投影，O(T^{-1/2})收敛，每步O(mn log n)
2505.13660.tldr_en: Constraint-free concave dual with Sobolev gradient ascent computes exact barycenter without c-concave projection, O(T^{-1/2}) rate

2505.18193.title: Riemannian Flow Matching for Brain Connectivity Matrices via Pullback Geometry
2505.18193.tldr_zh: 全局微分同胚 pullback 度量下，黎曼 CFM 等价于变换后欧氏 CFM；SPD 用矩阵对数、相关矩阵用归一化 Cholesky，训练快 8 倍采样快 10 倍
2505.18193.tldr_en: Pullback metrics from global diffeomorphisms make Riemannian CFM equivalent to Euclidean CFM after transformation; 8x faster training, 10x faster sampling on SPD/correlation matrices

2505.18521.title: Improved Immiscible Diffusion: Accelerate Diffusion Training by Reducing Its Miscibility
2505.18521.tldr_zh: 把噪声指派推广为降低轨迹可混性，KNN 噪声选择 O(n)、0.2ms/256；CIFAR-10 DDIM FID 6.63→4.45，训练加速 >4×
2505.18521.tldr_en: Generalizes immiscible diffusion to miscibility reduction; O(n) KNN noise selection and image scaling give up to 4x faster training, CIFAR-10 DDIM FID 6.63 to 4.45.

2505.18720.title: Optimal Transport-Based Token Weighting scheme for Enhanced Preference Optimization
2505.18720.tldr_zh: 用 unbalanced OT 对齐 chosen/rejected 回复的 token 分布，以传输计划边际重加权 DPO 损失
2505.18720.tldr_en: Unbalanced OT aligns chosen/rejected token distributions; transport plan marginals reweight DPO loss

2505.19476.title: FlowSE: Efficient and High-Quality Speech Enhancement via Flow Matching
2505.19476.tldr_zh: FM 语音增强：noisy mel 单程变换到 clean mel，RTF 0.31，DNSMOS 最高 3.643
2505.19476.tldr_en: Flow matching SE: noisy-to-clean mel in one pass, RTF 0.31, DNSMOS up to 3.643

2505.19712.title: On the Relation between Rectified Flows and Optimal Transport
2505.19712.tldr_zh: 反例证明梯度约束 reflow 有非最优不动点、损失趋零不蕴含最优；Liu22 Thm 5.6 需加连通支撑假设
2505.19712.tldr_en: Counterexamples show gradient-constrained reflow has non-optimal fixed points and vanishing loss does not imply optimality; Liu22 Thm 5.6 needs connected-support assumption.

2505.21528.title: A Unified and Fast-Sampling Diffusion Bridge Framework via Stochastic Optimal Control
2505.21528.tldr_zh: SOC统一扩散桥，h-transform为γ→∞特例；可调γ改善细节，闭式解加速
2505.21528.tldr_en: Unifies diffusion bridges via stochastic optimal control; Doob's h-transform is the infinite-terminal-penalty limit; tunable penalty plus closed-form reverse SDE.

2506.05526.title: On Fitting Flow Models with Large Sinkhorn Couplings
2506.05526.tldr_zh: 作者报告把 Sinkhorn 耦合分片扩到 n≈2×10⁶ 后 OT-FM 才明显获益；n≈256 的微弱收益是小 batch 伪象。
2506.05526.tldr_en: Sharded multi-GPU Sinkhorn couplings with n up to 2M and low epsilon make OT flow matching pay off; n~256 gains were a small-batch artifact.

2506.07534.title: Flowing Datasets with Wasserstein over Wasserstein Gradient Flows
2506.07534.tldr_zh: 在 WoW 空间上建立梯度流理论，用 MMD-SW 目标流动整个带标签数据集，应用于迁移学习与蒸馏
2506.07534.tldr_en: Defines gradient flows on the Wasserstein-over-Wasserstein space to flow entire labeled datasets for transfer learning and distillation

2506.08009.title: Self Forcing: Bridging the Train-Test Gap in Autoregressive Video Diffusion
2506.08009.tldr_zh: 训练时自回归 self-rollout 加视频级分布匹配损失消除曝光偏差，单 H100 17 FPS 实时生成
2506.08009.tldr_en: Training-time autoregressive self-rollout with video-level distribution matching eliminates exposure bias, enabling 17 FPS real-time generation on one H100

2506.09007.title: Branched Schrödinger Bridge Matching
2506.09007.tldr_zh: 把广义SB拆成多条带权unbalanced随机最优控制分支，学分支速度场+增长网络，重建多模态终点与分叉轨迹
2506.09007.tldr_en: Decomposes generalized SB into weighted unbalanced SOC branches with per-branch velocity and growth networks for multimodal endpoints

2506.09018.title: Edit Flows: Flow Matching with Edit Operations
2506.09018.tldr_zh: 在整条序列空间上定义 CTMC，转移=插入/删除/替换，经辅助对齐过程+Bregman 散度损失可训练，原生支持变长生成
2506.09018.tldr_en: CTMC over full sequence space with insert/delete/substitute transitions; trained via auxiliary alignment process and Bregman divergence loss; natively supports variable-length generation

2506.09350.title: Autoregressive Adversarial Post-Training for Real-Time Interactive Video Generation
2506.09350.tldr_zh: 对抗后训练把视频扩散模型改成1NFE/帧自回归生成器，单H100达24fps实时流式生成
2506.09350.tldr_en: Adversarial post-training turns video diffusion into 1NFE/frame autoregressive generator, 24fps real-time on one H100

2506.09534.title: Gaussian Herding across Pens: An Optimal Transport Perspective on Global Gaussian Reduction for 3DGS
2506.09534.tldr_zh: 把 3DGS 压缩视为 Gaussian 混合约简，用 CTD 做块级几何压缩，10% 图元保持渲染质量
2506.09534.tldr_en: Casts 3DGS compaction as Gaussian mixture reduction via composite transport divergence, retaining 10% primitives with negligible quality loss

2506.10168.title: Momentum Multi-Marginal Schrödinger Bridge Matching
2506.10168.tldr_zh: 相空间提升+多点条件化随机桥，学习满足多个位置约束的测度值样条；matching 迭代中保持中间边缘不变，解决两两插值丢失长程时序依赖的问题
2506.10168.tldr_en: Phase-space lifting with multi-point conditional bridges learns smooth measure-valued splines satisfying multiple positional constraints; matching preserves intermediate marginals throughout training

2506.10177.title: Geometric Regularity in Deterministic Sampling Dynamics of Diffusion-based Generative Models
2506.10177.tldr_zh: 扩散采样轨迹呈低维回旋镖形，KDE 闭式解等价 annealed mean-shift，DP 调度加速 5–10 NFE 生成
2506.10177.tldr_en: Diffusion sampling trajectories show low-dimensional boomerang shape; KDE closed form links to annealed mean-shift; DP schedule accelerates 5-10 NFE generation

2506.10892.title: The Diffusion Duality
2506.10892.tldr_zh: 证明 uniform 离散扩散是高斯扩散的 argmax 投影，借此引入课程学习与离散一致性蒸馏，采样加速两个数量级
2506.10892.tldr_en: Shows uniform-state discrete diffusion emerges from Gaussian diffusion via argmax projection, enabling curriculum learning and discrete consistency distillation for 2-orders-of-magnitude faster sampling

2506.13579.title: Flexible-length Text Infilling for Discrete Diffusion Models
2506.13579.tldr_zh: DDOT 用 sample-level OT 位置耦合让离散扩散同时去噪 token 值与位置，首次实现无 ground-truth 位置数据的灵活长度/位置文本填充。
2506.13579.tldr_en: DDOT jointly denoises token values and positions with sample-level OT coupling, enabling flexible-length text infilling in discrete diffusion without ground-truth positions.

2506.15742.title: FLUX.1 Kontext: Flow Matching for In-Context Image Generation and Editing in Latent Space
2506.15742.tldr_zh: 12B rectified flow transformer 用序列拼接统一图像生成与编辑，LADD 蒸馏实现 3–5 秒 1024² 生成
2506.15742.tldr_en: 12B rectified flow transformer unifies image generation and editing via sequence concatenation, with LADD distillation for 3-5s 1024² generation

2507.03745.title: StreamDiT: Real-Time Streaming Text-to-Video Generation
2507.03745.tldr_zh: 流匹配加移动缓冲训练 4B 模型，蒸馏后单 GPU 16 FPS 流式生成 512p 视频
2507.03745.tldr_en: Flow matching with moving buffer trains 4B model; distilled to 16 FPS streaming 512p on one GPU

2507.10218.title: Straighten Viscous Rectified Flow via Noise Optimization
2507.10218.tldr_zh: 编码器把真实图像映成 (μ,σ²) 重参数化噪声、与真实图像直接配对训练，加历史速度项；CIFAR-10 一步 FID 4.50，但采样也需输入数据集图像
2507.10218.tldr_en: VRFNO pairs real images with encoder-reparameterized noise (VAE-style, KL-regularized) plus a historical-velocity input; one-step CIFAR-10 FID 4.50, yet sampling also consumes dataset images.

2507.11925.title: Schrödinger Bridge Consistency Trajectory Models for Speech Enhancement
2507.11925.tldr_zh: 把 CTM 轨迹蒸馏接到 SB 语音增强，一步推理 RTF 约 16× 提升，PESQ 超教师模型
2507.11925.tldr_en: Applies CTM distillation to Schrödinger bridge speech enhancement; 1-step RTF ~16× faster, PESQ exceeds teacher

2508.02363.title: Optimal Transport for Rectified Flow Image Editing: Unifying Inversion-Based and Direct Methods
2508.02363.tldr_zh: 用闭式 OT 位移方向校正 RF 编辑轨迹，统一 inversion 与 FlowEdit，training-free 提升重建与一致性
2508.02363.tldr_en: Closed-form OT displacement corrects RF editing trajectories for both inversion and FlowEdit, training-free

2508.15487.title: Dream 7B: Diffusion Large Language Models
2508.15487.tldr_zh: AR 初始化 + token 级噪声重调度训练 7B 扩散 LM，规划任务超同规模 AR
2508.15487.tldr_en: 7B diffusion LM via AR init and token-level noise rescheduling, beats AR on planning

2508.16306.title: A Sharp KL-Convergence Analysis for Diffusion Models under Minimal Assumptions
2508.16306.tldr_zh: 「PF-ODE 双步+前向加噪单步」把 KL 迭代复杂度从 Õ(d/ε²) 提到 Õ(d log^{3/2}(1/δ)/ε)，仅需 L² score 与二阶矩（预印本）
2508.16306.tldr_en: Preprint: an ODE-step-plus-forward-noising scheme achieves ε²-KL in Õ(d log^{3/2}(1/δ)/ε) steps under L2-accurate scores and finite second moment, improving Õ(d/ε²).

2509.16974.title: Hessian-guided Perturbed Wasserstein Gradient Flows for Escaping Saddle Points
2509.16974.tldr_zh: PWGF 沿 Wasserstein Hessian 最小特征方向注入 GP 扰动，给出测度空间非凸优化二阶最优性保证
2509.16974.tldr_en: PWGF injects Hessian-guided GP perturbations to escape saddle points in Wasserstein space with polynomial-time second-order guarantees

2509.22494.title: A dynamical formulation of multi-marginal optimal transport
2509.22494.tldr_zh: 把 MMOT 静态问题写成耦合流的动力学凸优化，给出 quasi-Monge 解
2509.22494.tldr_en: Dynamical convex formulation of MMOT via coupling flows, yielding quasi-Monge solutions

2509.25519.title: Flow Matching with Semidiscrete Couplings
2509.25519.tldr_zh: 用全数据集半离散 OT 势函数替代 minibatch OT 配对，训练时 O(N) MIPS 指派噪声，FID 优于 I-FM 且开销远低于 OT-FM。
2509.25519.tldr_en: Replaces minibatch OT with dataset-level semidiscrete OT potentials; O(N) MIPS pairing at train time beats I-FM on FID with negligible overhead vs OT-FM.

2510.00983.title: Riemannian Consistency Model
2510.00983.tldr_zh: 用指数映射+协变导数把一致性模型推广到黎曼流形，2步生成优于RFM-2与欧氏CM
2510.00983.tldr_en: Extends consistency models to Riemannian manifolds via exp-map parameterization and covariant derivatives, enabling 2-step generation

2510.01894.title: Multi-marginal temporal Schrödinger Bridge Matching from unpaired data
2510.01894.tldr_zh: IMF 按时间段因子化推广到多边缘（IMFF）；100 维单细胞 MMD 比 DMSB 低 41%，首次从非配对快照生成视频
2510.01894.tldr_en: Factorized multi-marginal IMF (IMFF) extends DSBM to time-ordered snapshots; authors report -41% MMD vs DMSB on 100-d EB and first unpaired video generation.

2510.02390.title: F-scheduler: illuminating the free-lunch design space for fast sampling of diffusion models
2510.02390.tldr_zh: 免训练调度器配合 Free-U 与 β-VAE 噪声容忍，6 步 1024² 采样 FID 超过部分蒸馏模型
2510.02390.tldr_en: Training-free scheduler with Free-U and β-VAE noise tolerance achieves 6-step 1024² sampling FID surpassing some distilled models

2510.04602.title: Wasserstein Gradient Flows for Scalable and Regularized Barycenter Computation
2510.04602.tldr_zh: 把 barycenter 写成 Wasserstein 梯度流，mini-batch OT 提速 2–50×，支持标签与正则，DA 上 SOTA
2510.04602.tldr_en: Barycenter as Wasserstein gradient flow with mini-batch OT, 2-50x speedup, label-aware regularization, SOTA DA

2510.20871.title: Exponential Convergence Guarantees for Iterative Markovian Fitting
2510.20871.tldr_zh: 首次给出 IMF 非渐近指数收敛率，覆盖对数凹与弱对数凹边缘分布
2510.20871.tldr_en: First non-asymptotic exponential convergence rate for IMF under log-concave and weakly log-concave marginals

2510.22560.title: Statistical Analysis of the Sinkhorn Iterations for Two-Sample Schrödinger Bridge Estimation
2510.22560.tldr_zh: 两样本 Sinkhorn bridge 的 TV² 误差 O(1/m+1/n+r^{4k})；[SF]²M/LightSB(-M)/DSBM-IMF/BM² 的最优估计量与之相同
2510.22560.tldr_en: Two-sample Sinkhorn bridge error is O(1/m+1/n+r^{4k}) in squared TV; [SF]2M, LightSB(-M), DSBM-IMF and BM2 share this estimator and hence the guarantee.

2511.07499.title: Toward the Frontiers of Reliable Diffusion Sampling via Adversarial Sinkhorn Attention Guidance
2511.07499.tldr_zh: 用对抗代价的 Sinkhorn attention 构造劣化分支做 guidance，免训练提升扩散采样保真度
2511.07499.tldr_en: Adversarial Sinkhorn attention builds degraded branch for guidance, training-free fidelity gains

2511.11162.title: OT-ALD: Aligning Latent Distributions with Optimal Transport for Accelerated Image-to-Image Translation
2511.11162.tldr_zh: 用显式 OT map 对齐 DDIB 两域 latent 分布后再反向去噪，平均提速 20.29%、FID 降 2.6
2511.11162.tldr_en: Aligns DDIB latent distributions via explicit OT map before reverse diffusion, achieving 20.29% speedup and 2.6 lower FID

2511.18679.title: Neural Geometry Image-Based Representations with Optimal Transport (OT)
2511.18679.tldr_zh: Ricci flow 共形参数化后用 OT 校正面积畸变，得到保面积 geometry image，低分辨率 mipmap 经单趟 CNN 超分重建网格，CR=64 时 CD/HD 优于 NCS 等基线
2511.18679.tldr_en: OT-corrected area-preserving geometry images enable single-pass CNN super-resolution mesh reconstruction with continuous GPU LoD

2511.22425.title: Wukong's 72 Transformations: High-fidelity Textured 3D Morphing via Flow Models
2511.22425.tldr_zh: 在预训练 3D flow transformer 条件 token 空间解 free-support barycenter，training-free 实现带纹理 3D 形变
2511.22425.tldr_en: Training-free textured 3D morphing by solving free-support Wasserstein barycenter in condition token space of a pretrained flow transformer

2512.06797.title: Optimal and Diffusion Transports in Machine Learning
2512.06797.tldr_zh: 用连续性方程与速度场非唯一性统一 flow matching、OT、W 梯度流与 transformer PDE 的非形式化综述
2512.06797.tldr_en: Informal survey unifying flow matching, OT, Wasserstein gradient flows and transformer PDEs via the continuity equation and non-unique velocity fields.

2512.06802.title: VDOT: Efficient Unified Video Creation via Optimal Transport Distillation
2512.06802.tldr_zh: 熵正则 OT 距离加入 DMD，4 步统一视频生成匹敌 100 步 VACE-Wan-14B
2512.06802.tldr_en: Entropic OT regularizer added to DMD enables 4-step unified video creation matching 100-step VACE-Wan-14B

2512.11438.title: Flowception: Temporally Expansive Flow Matching for Video Generation
2512.11438.tldr_zh: 把离散帧插入编进 flow matching 概率路径，非自回归变长视频生成，训练 FLOPs 降 3 倍
2512.11438.tldr_en: Interleaves discrete frame insertion with continuous flow denoising in one probability path for variable-length non-AR video generation

2512.22796.title: Parallel Diffusion Solver via Residual Dirichlet Policy Optimization
2512.22796.tldr_zh: 每步并行评估 K 个学得中点梯度做单纯形加权，蒸馏+Dirichlet 残差策略 RL；5 NFE CIFAR-10 FID 4.33
2512.22796.tldr_en: K parallel gradients at learned intermediate times, simplex-weighted; distillation then Dirichlet residual policy RL; CIFAR-10 FID 4.33 at 5 NFE without added latency.

2601.06810.title: WFR-FM: Simulation-Free Dynamic Unbalanced Optimal Transport
2601.06810.tldr_zh: 同时回归速度场与增长率，最小化损失恰好回收 WFR 测地线，免模拟解动态非平衡 OT
2601.06810.tldr_en: Jointly regresses velocity and growth rate; minimizing loss exactly recovers WFR geodesics simulation-free

2601.07568.title: d3LLM: Ultra-Fast Diffusion LLM using Pseudo-Trajectory Distillation
2601.07568.tldr_zh: 伪轨迹蒸馏+熵基多块解码，AUP 指标 9/10 任务最优，H100 上 5× 快于 AR、10× 快于 vanilla dLLM
2601.07568.tldr_en: Pseudo-trajectory distillation plus multi-block decoding achieves 5x AR speedup and 10x vanilla dLLM speedup on H100

2601.08011.title: TP-Blend: Textual-Prompt Attention Pairing for Precise Object-Style Blending in Diffusion Models
2601.08011.tldr_zh: TP-Blend 用熵正则 OT 在 cross-attention 全头维度上重分配特征，实现对象与风格双 prompt 融合
2601.08011.tldr_en: TP-Blend uses entropy-regularized OT on full multi-head cross-attention features for dual-prompt object-style blending

2602.01179.title: Rethinking the Flow-Based Gradual Domain Adaptation: A Semi-Dual Optimal Transport Perspective
2602.01179.tldr_zh: 用熵正则半对偶 UOT 替代目标 PDF 估计，逐步生成 GDA 中间域，三个 GDA 数据集与 Office-Home 上精度最高
2602.01179.tldr_en: Entropy-regularized semi-dual UOT replaces target PDF estimation for flow-based GDA intermediate domain generation, achieving best accuracy on GDA and Office-Home benchmarks

2602.03067.title: FlashSinkhorn: IO-Aware Entropic Optimal Transport on GPU
2602.03067.tldr_zh: Sinkhorn 更新重写为 biased-LSE，Triton 流式融合，A100 前向最高 32×、端到端 161×
2602.03067.tldr_en: Rewrites Sinkhorn as biased-LSE, streams via fused Triton kernels; up to 32x fwd, 161x e2e on A100

2602.03105.title: Gromov Wasserstein Optimal Transport for Semantic Correspondences
2602.03105.tldr_zh: 用 GW 空间平滑先验的 OT 匹配替代最近邻，DINOv2 单模型即可竞争 SD ensemble，快 5–10 倍
2602.03105.tldr_en: GW spatial smoothness prior in OT matching replaces SD features, DINOv2-only competitive at 5-10x speedup

2602.03566.title: Riemannian Neural Optimal Transport
2602.03566.tldr_zh: 证明离散化流形 OT 必遭维数灾难，提出 c-凹神经势 RNOT 以次指数复杂度逼近连续 OT map
2602.03566.tldr_en: Proves discrete manifold OT suffers CoD; introduces c-concave neural potential RNOT with sub-exponential complexity

2602.06658.title: Gromov-Wasserstein at Scale, Beyond Squared Norms
2602.06658.tldr_zh: CNT 代价下 GW 分解为 lifted 线性对齐 + 平方欧氏 OT，线性内存、二次时间、可微、可探索能量景观
2602.06658.tldr_en: CNT-cost GW reduces to lifted linear alignment plus squared-Euclidean OT, enabling linear memory, quadratic time, differentiable solvers

2602.15008.title: Efficient Sampling with Discrete Diffusion Models: Sharp and Adaptive Guarantees
2602.15008.tldr_zh: τ-leaping 达 O(d/ε) KL 复杂度并匹配下界；masked 由有效总相关自适应控制，可亚线性
2602.15008.tldr_en: Sharp O(d/eps) KL bound for tau-leaping with matching lower bound; masking adapts via effective total correlation

2603.00763.title: Analyzing and Improving Fast Sampling of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
2603.00763.tldr_zh: 消融 T2I 免训练五组件，外调度最关键；Frenet–Serret 总旋转等分调度，Flux 10 步达 20 步基线
2603.00763.tldr_en: Ablates five training-free T2I acceleration components; schedule dominates. TORS equidistributes Frenet-Serret total rotation; Flux.1-Dev 10 steps match 20-step baseline.

2603.06972.title: Conditional Unbalanced Optimal Transport Maps: An Outlier-Robust Framework for Conditional Generative Modeling
2603.06972.tldr_zh: 条件 UOT 半对偶 + 三角 c-transform，单步条件生成，抗 outlier 且 CIFAR-10 FID 3.71
2603.06972.tldr_en: Conditional UOT semi-dual with triangular c-transform; one-step conditional generation, outlier-robust, FID 3.71 on CIFAR-10

2603.11618.title: Shape-of-You: Fused Gromov-Wasserstein Optimal Transport for Semantic Correspondence in-the-Wild
2603.11618.tldr_zh: 用 3D 几何结构做 FGW 伪标签，anchor 线性化降计算，SPair-71k 达 67.9% PCK@0.1
2603.11618.tldr_en: FGW pseudo-labels with 3D geometric structure and anchor linearization; 67.9% PCK@0.1 on SPair-71k

2603.15279.title: Faster Inference of Flow-Based Generative Models via Improved Data-Noise Coupling
2603.15279.tldr_zh: LOOM-CFM 跨 minibatch 保存并迭代更新噪声–数据配对，12 NFE 下 FID 比 minibatch OT 低 41–54%。
2603.15279.tldr_en: LOOM-CFM persists and locally refines noise-data assignments across minibatches, cutting 12-NFE FID by 41-54% vs minibatch OT with negligible overhead.

2603.18992.title: Foundations of Schrödinger Bridges for Generative Modeling
2603.18992.tldr_zh: 220 页自足教程：静态/动态 SB、随机控制、FBSDE、Markov/reciprocal 投影、离散 SB，统一 diffusion/score/flow matching
2603.18992.tldr_en: 220-page self-contained tutorial deriving static/dynamic SB, stochastic control, FBSDEs, Markovian/reciprocal projections and discrete SB as one framework for generative modeling.

2603.25182.title: Learning Monge maps with constrained drifting models
2603.25182.tldr_zh: 在OT映射凸锥内做KL约束梯度流，证明长时存在并维数无关指数收敛到Monge映射；参数化=自然梯度，玩具MMD 0.019 vs Adam 0.029
2603.25182.tldr_en: Constrained gradient flow of KL inside the convex cone of OT maps exists globally and converges to the Monge map at a dimension-free exponential rate; parameterized version is natural gradient descent (toy MMD 0.019 vs Adam 0.029).

2605.00161.title: Consistent Diffusion Language Models
2605.00161.tldr_zh: 用精确后验桥做多路径离散一致性训练，单阶段 teacher-free 模型在 few-step 文本生成上超过蒸馏基线
2605.00161.tldr_en: Exact posterior bridges replace PF-ODE for multi-path discrete consistency; single-stage teacher-free CDLM beats distilled baselines in few-step text generation

2605.00837.title: Fast Log-Domain Sinkhorn Optimal Transport with Warp-Level GPU Reductions
2605.00837.tldr_zh: 原生 CUDA log-domain Sinkhorn，warp shuffle 归约，n=8192 比 POT 快 12×，ε 低至 1e-4 稳定
2605.00837.tldr_en: Native CUDA log-domain Sinkhorn with warp shuffle; 12x over POT at n=8192, stable to eps=1e-4

2605.08793.title: cuRegOT: A GPU-Accelerated Solver for Entropic-Regularized Optimal Transport
2605.08793.tldr_zh: 把 SPLR 拟牛顿 OT 求解器 GPU 化，摊销符号分析+异步 Sinkhorn 候选+融合梯度 kernel，小 η 难例上快于 Sinkhorn 系
2605.08793.tldr_en: GPU-accelerated SPLR quasi-Newton OT solver with amortized symbolic analysis, async Sinkhorn candidates, and fused gradient kernel

2605.11429.title: From Schrödinger Bridge to Optimal Transport over Sub-Riemannian Manifolds
2605.11429.tldr_zh: 沿控制方向加噪声定义退化 SB：bracket-generating 下适定、强对偶，ε→0 收敛到 sub-Riemannian OT
2605.11429.tldr_en: Noise only along control directions yields a well-posed hypoelliptic SB under bracket-generating assumptions; strong duality and convergence to sub-Riemannian OT as noise vanishes.

2605.11755.title: One-Step Generative Modeling via Wasserstein Gradient Flows
2605.11755.tldr_zh: W-Flow 用 Sinkhorn divergence 的 WGF 速度场 T_{q,p}−T_{q,q} 规定训练期粒子演化，一步生成器回归之；作者报告 ImageNet-256 一步 FID 1.29
2605.11755.tldr_en: W-Flow drives a one-step generator by the Wasserstein gradient flow of the Sinkhorn divergence (cross minus self barycentric maps); authors report 1.29 FID on ImageNet-256 in 1 NFE.

2605.12174.title: Expected Batch Optimal Transport Plans and Consequences for Flow Matching
2605.12174.tldr_zh: 期望 batch OT 耦合 π̄_k 在半离散情形有成本 O(k^{-1/2})、plan O(k^{-1/4}) 收敛速率，FM 速度场良定；增大 batch 主要改善低 NFE 采样。
2605.12174.tldr_en: Expected batch OT plan converges at O(k^{-1/2}) cost bias and O(k^{-1/4}) plan rate in semidiscrete case; FM velocity field is well-posed; larger batch mainly helps low-NFE sampling.

2605.17232.title: Dimension-Free Convergence of Discrete Diffusion Models: Adjoint Equations Induce the Right Space
2605.17232.tldr_zh: 伴随方程框架给出任意 IPM 下不依赖词表大小 S 的离散扩散收敛界，首次同时覆盖 masked 与 uniform 先验
2605.17232.tldr_en: Adjoint-equation framework yields S-free convergence bounds in any IPM for discrete diffusion, covering both masked and uniform priors

2606.05327.title: Multimarginal flow matching with optimal transport potentials
2606.05327.tldr_zh: 把逐段CFM的中间边缘硬约束松弛为动态OT作用量中的软势能项，得到simulation-free多边缘FM，并给出势强度—Wasserstein偏差界
2606.05327.tldr_en: Relaxes piecewise CFM hard marginal constraints into soft potential terms in the dynamic OT action, yielding simulation-free multimarginal FM with Wasserstein alignment bounds

2606.11221.title: LAST: Bridging Vision-Language and Action Manifolds via Gromov-Wasserstein Alignment
2606.11221.tldr_zh: LAST 用 Lie 代数线性化与协方差白化重构动作空间，LIBERO 平均成功率 95.8%
2606.11221.tldr_en: LAST linearizes SE(3) actions via Lie algebra and whitens residuals for VL-compatible action tokenization

2606.29462.title: MIRROR: Aligning Semantic Relations from Language to Image via Gromov–Wasserstein
2606.29462.tldr_zh: 把 GW 逆问题做成 MLLM 训练正则，闭式解给出理想视觉几何，关系推理提升且通用 VQA 不降
2606.29462.tldr_en: Semi-inverse GW regularizer aligns visual geometry to language relational structure in MLLMs, improving relational reasoning without hurting general VQA

2607.03626.title: Reflected Schrödinger Bridge Matching
2607.03626.tldr_zh: 把 α-DSBM 推广到单位立方体上的反射 Brownian 参考过程，样本不越界，训练开销约 +1.5%
2607.03626.tldr_en: Extends alpha-DSBM to reflected Brownian reference on the unit cube via closed-form reflected score and bridge sampler; negligible overhead, samples stay in-domain.

2607.07401.title: Heterogeneity-Adaptive Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge for PET-Guided Whole-Body MRI Translation
2607.07401.tldr_zh: I2SB 配对桥做全身 LAVA→T2，VLM 区域嵌入 + PET 空间噪声调制/注意力；作者报告 SSIM 91.1% 超 ResViT 4.5 pp，病灶切片 PET 引导 +0.8 dB
2607.07401.tldr_en: I2SB bridge for whole-body LAVA-to-T2 MRI with VLM-derived region embeddings and PET-guided spatial noise modulation/attention; authors report SSIM 91.1% (+4.5 pp over ResViT), +0.8 dB on lesion slices.

ASBM_Adversarial_Schr_dinger_Bridge_Matc.title: ASBM: Adversarial Schrödinger Bridge Matching
ASBM_Adversarial_Schr_dinger_Bridge_Matc.tldr_zh: 离散时间 IMF 用 DD-GAN 实现，几步推理达到连续 IMF 百步的非配对翻译质量
ASBM_Adversarial_Schr_dinger_Bridge_Matc.tldr_en: Discrete-time IMF with DD-GAN matches continuous IMF's 100-step quality in a few steps

A_Combinatorial_Algorithm_for_Semi_Discr.title: A Combinatorial Algorithm for Semi-Discrete Optimal Transport
A_Combinatorial_Algorithm_for_Semi_Discr.tldr_zh: 提出半离散 OT 的组合算法路径，区别于主流 smooth dual/Newton 方法
A_Combinatorial_Algorithm_for_Semi_Discr.tldr_en: A combinatorial algorithm path for semi-discrete OT, distinct from smooth dual/Newton methods

A_Memory_Efficient_Hierarchical_Algorith.title: A Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Algorithm for Large-scale OT (HALO)
A_Memory_Efficient_Hierarchical_Algorith.tldr_zh: HALO 组合层次 warm-start、active 剪枝与一阶 LP 求解器，报告 O(n) 内存与 1024² 图像 8.9× 加速、省 70.5% 显存。
A_Memory_Efficient_Hierarchical_Algorith.tldr_en: HALO combines hierarchical warm-start, active support pruning, and a first-order LP solver, reporting O(n) memory with 8.9× speedup and 70.5% memory savings on 1024² images.

A_computational_fluid_mechanics_solution.title: A computational fluid mechanics solution to the Monge–Kantorovich mass transfer problem
A_computational_fluid_mechanics_solution.tldr_zh: 把 W2² 写成连续性方程约束下的最小动能，给出动态流形式的 OT 数值入口。
A_computational_fluid_mechanics_solution.tldr_en: W2² equals minimal kinetic energy under continuity equation, giving a dynamic fluid formulation of OT.

Adversarial_SB_Matching_ASBM_Gushchin_et.title: Adversarial SB Matching (ASBM), Gushchin et al.
Adversarial_SB_Matching_ASBM_Gushchin_et.tldr_zh: 离散时间 IMF 理论 + DD-GAN，把 SB 推断从数百步降到几步
Adversarial_SB_Matching_ASBM_Gushchin_et.tldr_en: Discrete-time IMF theory with DD-GAN cuts SB inference from hundreds of steps to a few

An_Invitation_to_Optimal_Transport_Wasse.title: An Invitation to Optimal Transport, Wasserstein Distances, and Gradient Flows
An_Invitation_to_Optimal_Transport_Wasse.tldr_zh: 146 页最短严格 OT 入门教材，覆盖对偶、Brenier、W 距离、JKO/Otto 微积分，含带解答习题。
An_Invitation_to_Optimal_Transport_Wasse.tldr_en: A 146-page minimal rigorous OT textbook covering duality, Brenier, Wasserstein distances, JKO/Otto calculus, with solved exercises.

An_Optimal_Transport_View_of_Activation_.title: An Optimal Transport View of Activation Steering in Masked Diffusion Models
An_Optimal_Transport_View_of_Activation_.tldr_zh: 把 dLLM 激活转向统一为仿射 OT map，推理零开销提升指令遵循
An_Optimal_Transport_View_of_Activation_.tldr_en: Unifies dLLM activation steering as affine OT maps with moment matching

Anatomy_Conserving_Unpaired_CBCT_to_CT_T.title: Anatomy-Conserving Unpaired CBCT-to-CT Translation via Schrödinger Bridge
Anatomy_Conserving_Unpaired_CBCT_to_CT_T.tldr_zh: UNSB 骨架 + AC-ViT 生成器 + 焦点频率损失做无配对 CBCT→CT，跨区泛化最好，但只报像素指标
Anatomy_Conserving_Unpaired_CBCT_to_CT_T.tldr_en: UNSB-style Schrödinger bridge with an AC-ViT generator and focal frequency loss for unpaired CBCT-to-CT; best PSNR/MAE intra- and cross-region, pixel metrics only.

Categorical_SB_Matching_CSBM_Ksenofontov.title: Categorical SB Matching (CSBM), Ksenofontov & Korotin
Categorical_SB_Matching_CSBM_Ksenofontov.tldr_zh: 离散有限状态空间上 D-IMF 收敛到 SB，推广 SB matching 到离散数据
Categorical_SB_Matching_CSBM_Ksenofontov.tldr_en: Proves D-IMF converges to SB on discrete finite state spaces, extending SB matching to discrete data

Composing_Unbalanced_Flows_for_Flexible_.title: Composing Unbalanced Flows for Flexible Docking and Relaxation / FlexDock (ICLR 2025)
Composing_Unbalanced_Flows_for_Flexible_.tldr_zh: 提出 Unbalanced Flow Matching 松弛边缘约束，链式 apo→holo 对接 + 全原子松弛，PoseBusters 合格率 30%→73%
Composing_Unbalanced_Flows_for_Flexible_.tldr_en: Unbalanced Flow Matching relaxes marginal constraints for easier couplings; chained apo-to-holo manifold docking plus all-atom relaxation lifts PoseBusters validity from 30% to 73%

DMD2_Improved_Distribution_Matching_Dist.title: DMD2: Improved Distribution Matching Distillation
DMD2_Improved_Distribution_Matching_Dist.tldr_zh: 去掉 ODE 对回归，TTUR+GAN 稳定纯分布匹配；一步 ImageNet-64 FID 1.28 超教师
DMD2_Improved_Distribution_Matching_Dist.tldr_en: Removes ODE pair regression, uses TTUR+GAN for stable pure distribution matching; 1-step ImageNet-64 FID 1.28 beats teacher

DeST_OT_Alignment_of_Spatiotemporal_Tran.title: DeST-OT: Alignment of Spatiotemporal Transcriptomics Data
DeST_OT_Alignment_of_Spatiotemporal_Tran.tldr_zh: 用 semi-relaxed FGW 对齐时空转录组切片，建模生长/凋亡/分化并给出 growth-distortion 与 migration 度量。
DeST_OT_Alignment_of_Spatiotemporal_Tran.tldr_en: Aligns spatiotemporal transcriptomics slices via semi-relaxed FGW, modeling growth/apoptosis/differentiation with growth-distortion and migration metrics.

Deep_Momentum_Multi_Marginal_SB_DMSB_Che.title: Deep Momentum Multi-Marginal SB (DMSB), Chen et al.
Deep_Momentum_Multi_Marginal_SB_DMSB_Che.tldr_zh: 相空间 Bregman-IPF 解多边缘 SB，从位置快照重建速度分布
Deep_Momentum_Multi_Marginal_SB_DMSB_Che.tldr_en: Phase-space Bregman-IPF for multi-marginal SB, recovering velocity from position snapshots

Denoising_Diffusion_Probabilistic_Models.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models Are Optimally Adaptive to Unknown Low Dimensionality
Denoising_Diffusion_Probabilistic_Models.tldr_zh: （未读全文）DDPM 无需知道内在维数 k 即以近 k-线性迭代复杂度收敛，且 KL 下该依赖最优
Denoising_Diffusion_Probabilistic_Models.tldr_en: (Abstract-only) DDPM automatically attains nearly k-linear iteration complexity in intrinsic dimension k without knowing it, and this dependence is optimal in KL.

Density_aware_Chamfer_Distance.title: Density-aware Chamfer Distance
Density_aware_Chamfer_Distance.tldr_zh: 提出有界且密度敏感的 Chamfer 距离变体，弥补 CD 密度盲区与 EMD 高成本
Density_aware_Chamfer_Distance.tldr_en: Proposes a bounded, density-sensitive Chamfer Distance variant as a trainable loss

Diffusion_Adversarial_SB_via_IPMF_Kholki.title: Diffusion & Adversarial Schrödinger Bridges via Iterative Proportional Markovian Fitting (IPMF)
Diffusion_Adversarial_SB_via_IPMF_Kholki.tldr_zh: 证明双向交替 IMF 启发式 = IMF+IPF 组合（IPMF），多设定收敛，给相似度-质量旋钮
Diffusion_Adversarial_SB_via_IPMF_Kholki.tldr_en: Shows the practical bidirectional alternating IMF heuristic is an IMF+IPF combination (IPMF), proves convergence in several settings, exposes a similarity-quality knob.

Diffusion_Bridge_Mixture_Transports_IDBM.title: Diffusion Bridge Mixture Transports (IDBM), Peluchetti
Diffusion_Bridge_Mixture_Transports_IDBM.tldr_zh: 提出迭代扩散桥混合（IDBM），每步保持两端边缘合法 transport，给出收敛性初步分析。
Diffusion_Bridge_Mixture_Transports_IDBM.tldr_en: Proposes iterative diffusion bridge mixtures (IDBM) that preserve both marginals per iteration, with preliminary convergence analysis.

Diffusion_Models_are_Minimax_Optimal_Dis.title: Diffusion Models are Minimax Optimal Distribution Estimators
Diffusion_Models_are_Minimax_Optimal_Dis.tldr_zh: Besov 密度+经验 score matching：TV 率 n^{-s/(2s+d)} minimax、W1 率 n^{-(s+1-δ)/(2s+d)} 几乎 minimax；线性子空间数据率只含 d'
Diffusion_Models_are_Minimax_Optimal_Dis.tldr_en: With Besov-class densities and empirical score matching, diffusion models achieve minimax TV rate n^{-s/(2s+d)} and almost-minimax W1 rate; subspace data give intrinsic-dimension rates.

Diffusion_Schr_dinger_Bridge_DSB_De_Bort.title: Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge with Applications to Score-Based Generative Modeling (DSB)
Diffusion_Schr_dinger_Bridge_DSB_De_Bort.tldr_zh: score 网络实现 IPF 半步（学时间反转）求 SB，首次扩展到图像；SGM 是其第一次迭代
Diffusion_Schr_dinger_Bridge_DSB_De_Bort.tldr_en: Implements each IPF half-step as a learned time reversal with score networks; SGM is the first iteration; first SB solver at image scale.

Diffusion_Schr_dinger_Bridge_Matching.title: Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge Matching
Diffusion_Schr_dinger_Bridge_Matching.tldr_zh: IMF+桥匹配的通用SB求解器，翻译类桥方法的算法底座（详见T03）

Diffusion_Schr_dinger_Bridge_Matching_DS.title: Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge Matching
Diffusion_Schr_dinger_Bridge_Matching_DS.tldr_zh: 提出 IMF 交替 Markov/reciprocal 投影，DSBM 用 bridge-matching 回归实现，解决 DSB 误差累积与遗忘

Efficient_Algorithms_for_Robust_and_Part.title: Efficient Algorithms for Robust and Partial Semi-Discrete OT
Efficient_Algorithms_for_Robust_and_Part.tldr_zh: α-partial 与 λ-TV-robust 半离散 OT 的 restricted Laguerre 刻画与互归约
Efficient_Algorithms_for_Robust_and_Part.tldr_en: Restricted Laguerre characterization and mutual reduction for partial and TV-robust semi-discrete OT

Exposing_flaws_of_generative_model_evalu.title: Exposing flaws of generative model evaluation metrics and their unfair treatment of diffusion models
Exposing_flaws_of_generative_model_evalu.tldr_zh: 最大规模人评实验：现有生成评测指标与人评无强相关，Inception 特征压低扩散模型排名，建议换 DINOv2 特征。

F5_TTS_A_Fairytaler_that_Fakes_Fluent_an.title: F5-TTS: A Fairytaler that Fakes Fluent and Faithful Speech with Flow Matching
F5_TTS_A_Fairytaler_that_Fakes_Fluent_an.tldr_zh: ConvNeXt 精炼文本解决 E2 TTS 对齐鲁棒性，推理期 Sway Sampling 免重训重分配流步，RTF 0.15

Feedback_SB_Matching_FSBM_Theodoropoulos.title: Feedback Schrödinger Bridge Matching (FSBM)
Feedback_SB_Matching_FSBM_Theodoropoulos.tldr_zh: 半监督 SB：<8% 配对样本作为 state feedback 嵌入广义 EOT，作者报告训练加速、泛化提升
Feedback_SB_Matching_FSBM_Theodoropoulos.tldr_en: Semi-supervised SB: under 8% paired samples enter a generalized EOT objective as state feedback; authors report faster training and better generalization.

Finding_the_Center_of_a_Wasserstein_Ball.title: Finding the Center of a Wasserstein Ball
Finding_the_Center_of_a_Wasserstein_Ball.tldr_zh: Wasserstein ball 中心是 min-max 鲁棒聚合，与 barycenter 的 min-sum 视角互补
Finding_the_Center_of_a_Wasserstein_Ball.tldr_en: Wasserstein ball center as min-max robust aggregation, complementing barycenter's min-sum view

Flow_Map_Matching.title: Flow Map Matching

GOUB_Generalized_Ornstein_Uhlenbeck_Brid.title: GOUB: Generalized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Bridge
GOUB_Generalized_Ornstein_Uhlenbeck_Brid.tldr_zh: 广义OU过程上h-transform消掉稳态方差，得点对点修复桥并统一多种桥

Generalized_SB_Matching_GSBM_Liu_et_al.title: Generalized SB Matching (GSBM), Liu et al.

Gromov_Wasserstein_Averaging_of_Kernel_a.title: Gromov-Wasserstein Averaging of Kernel and Distance Matrices
Gromov_Wasserstein_Averaging_of_Kernel_a.tldr_zh: 提出 entropic GW 的投影镜像下降求解器与 GW barycenter，确立现代计算 GW 的基本范式。
Gromov_Wasserstein_Averaging_of_Kernel_a.tldr_en: Proposes projected mirror descent for entropic GW and GW barycenters, establishing the computational GW paradigm.

Harmonizing_Optical_Coherence_Tomography.title: Harmonizing OCT Across Devices with Latent-Metric Schrödinger Bridges (NeurIPS 2025)
Harmonizing_Optical_Coherence_Tomography.tldr_zh: 用可逆网络学潜空间度量替代欧氏成本再训 SB，跨设备 OCT 协调保解剖
Harmonizing_Optical_Coherence_Tomography.tldr_en: Learns a pullback latent metric via invertible network, then trains SB to preserve anatomy in cross-device OCT harmonization

Hyperparameter_Trajectory_Modeling_via_C.title: Hyperparameter Trajectory Modeling via Conditional Lagrangian Optimal Transport
Hyperparameter_Trajectory_Modeling_via_C.tldr_zh: 用条件 Lagrangian OT 建模超参数训练轨迹，摘要未给细节。

I2SB_Image_to_Image_Schr_dinger_Bridge.title: I2SB: Image-to-Image Schrödinger Bridge

I2SB_Image_to_Image_Schr_dinger_Bridge.tldr_en: Dirac boundary makes SB tractable and simulation-free; beats conditional diffusion on ImageNet-256 restoration

Improving_Dynamic_NeRFs_with_Optimal_Tra.title: Improving Dynamic NeRFs with Optimal Transport
Improving_Dynamic_NeRFs_with_Optimal_Tra.tldr_zh: 用 OT 约束动态 NeRF 的时变形变一致性，摘要无实验数字。

InfoCD_A_Contrastive_Chamfer_Distance_Lo.title: InfoCD: A Contrastive Chamfer Distance Loss for Point Cloud Completion
InfoCD_A_Contrastive_Chamfer_Distance_Lo.tldr_zh: 对比正则改进 CD，作者报告等价于最大化底层曲面互信息下界，被 UOT-UPC 选为最优 cost。

Joint_Velocity_Growth_Flow_Matching.title: Joint Velocity-Growth Flow Matching
Joint_Velocity_Growth_Flow_Matching.tldr_zh: 给静态 semi-relaxed OT 一个两段式动态解释，联合速度与增长的 simulation-free FM
Joint_Velocity_Growth_Flow_Matching.tldr_en: A two-stage dynamic view of static semi-relaxed OT, yielding a simulation-free FM for joint velocity and growth

Keypoint_Guided_Optimal_Transport.title: Keypoint-Guided Optimal Transport
Keypoint_Guided_Optimal_Transport.tldr_zh: 用 mask 约束 plan 加关系保持，把少量 keypoint 语义先验注入 OT，支持异构空间与 partial 设定。
Keypoint_Guided_Optimal_Transport.tldr_en: Inject sparse keypoint semantic priors into OT via mask-constrained plan and relation preservation, supporting heterogeneous spaces and partial settings.

L_onard_A_Survey_of_the_Schr_dinger_Prob.title: Léonard, A Survey of the Schrödinger Problem
L_onard_A_Survey_of_the_Schr_dinger_Prob.tldr_zh: 系统梳理 Schrödinger 问题：静态/动态等价、熵正则 OT 关系与大偏差极限
L_onard_A_Survey_of_the_Schr_dinger_Prob.tldr_en: A survey unifying static/dynamic Schrödinger problem, entropic OT, and large deviations

Latent_Schr_dinger_Bridge.title: Latent Schrödinger Bridge
Latent_Schr_dinger_Bridge.tldr_zh: SB PF-ODE速度场拆为源/目标/噪声三预测子，用预训练SD免训练近似
Latent_Schr_dinger_Bridge.tldr_en: Decomposes the SB probability-flow velocity into source, target and noise predictors from a pretrained Stable Diffusion with prompt optimization; training-free unpaired translation.

Learning_Single_Cell_Perturbation_Respon.title: Learning Single-Cell Perturbation Responses using Neural Optimal Transport
Learning_Single_Cell_Perturbation_Respon.tldr_zh: 用 ICNN 对偶势学 control→perturbed 的 Monge map，预测未见药物与病人的单细胞扰动响应。

Lectures_on_Optimal_Transport.title: Lectures on Optimal Transport

Light_and_Optimal_SB_Matching_LightSB_M_.title: Light and Optimal Schrödinger Bridge Matching
Light_and_Optimal_SB_Matching_LightSB_M_.tldr_zh: 证明任意耦合一次最优投影即得 SB；高斯混合势参数化实现 CPU 分钟级免迭代求解

Likelihood_Training_of_SB_using_FBSDEs_S.title: Likelihood Training of Schrödinger Bridge using Forward-Backward SDEs Theory

MIOFlow.title: MIOFlow

Mapping_Cells_Through_Time_and_Space_wit.title: Mapping Cells Through Time and Space with moscot

Modeling_Complex_System_Dynamics_with_Fl.title: Modeling Complex System Dynamics with Flow Matching Across Time and Conditions

Momentum_Multi_Marginal_SB_Matching_3MSB.title: Momentum Multi-Marginal Schrödinger Bridge Matching (3MSBM)

OT_StainNet_Optimal_Transport_Driven_Sem.title: OT-StainNet: Optimal Transport Driven Semantic Matching for Weakly Paired H&E-to-IHC Stain Transfer

Optimal_Entropy_Transport_Problems_and_a.title: Optimal Entropy-Transport Problems and a New Hellinger–Kantorovich Distance
Optimal_Entropy_Transport_Problems_and_a.tldr_zh: 系统化 KL 松弛边缘的熵-运输问题与 conic 提升，定义 Hellinger–Kantorovich 距离。

Optimal_Transport_Analysis_of_Single_Cel.title: Optimal-Transport Analysis of Single-Cell Gene Expression Identifies Developmental Trajectories in Reprogramming

Optimal_Transport_for_Applied_Mathematic.title: Optimal Transport for Applied Mathematicians

Optimizing_Functionals_on_the_Space_of_P.title: Optimizing Functionals on the Space of Probabilities with ICNNs
Optimizing_Functionals_on_the_Space_of_P.tldr_zh: 用 ICNN 参数化凸势求解 JKO 步，含收敛保证，摘要未给实验数字。

Overcoming_Spurious_Solutions_in_Semi_Du.title: Overcoming Spurious Solutions in Semi-Dual Neural Optimal Transport
Overcoming_Spurious_Solutions_in_Semi_Du.tldr_zh: 给出 semi-dual max-min 恢复真 OT map 的充分条件；源平滑化+退火可学随机 plan

PASB_Pathology_aware_Schr_dinger_Bridge_.title: PASB: Pathology-aware Schrödinger Bridge for Virtual Immunohistochemical Staining
PASB_Pathology_aware_Schr_dinger_Bridge_.tldr_zh: StainSB 升级：病理语义监督加相似度动态路径修正，下游诊断接近真实 IHC
PASB_Pathology_aware_Schr_dinger_Bridge_.tldr_en: StainSB upgrade with pathology-aware supervision and similarity-based path correction

PET_Image_Denoising_based_on_Diffusion_S.title: PET Image Denoising based on Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge Model
PET_Image_Denoising_based_on_Diffusion_S.tldr_zh: 低剂量 PET 去噪：从低剂量 PET 起步的 DSBM 加解剖 MR 先验，避免条件扩散过度增强 SNR。

P_Flow_A_Fast_and_Data_Efficient_Zero_Sh.title: P-Flow: A Fast and Data-Efficient Zero-Shot TTS through Speech Prompting
P_Flow_A_Fast_and_Data_Efficient_Zero_Sh.tldr_zh: speech prompt 编码器 + FM 解码器，用远少于 VALL-E 的数据达到同级说话人相似度、采样快约 20 倍

Partial_Fusion_of_Neural_Networks_via_Pa.title: Partial Fusion of Neural Networks via Partial Optimal Transport
Partial_Fusion_of_Neural_Networks_via_Pa.tldr_zh: 用 partial OT 放宽 OTFusion 完全匹配假设，允许神经元部分对应地融合。
Partial_Fusion_of_Neural_Networks_via_Pa.tldr_en: Relaxes OTFusion's full matching via partial OT for partially corresponding neurons.

Polar_factorization_and_monotone_rearran.title: Polar factorization and monotone rearrangement of vector-valued functions
Polar_factorization_and_monotone_rearran.tldr_zh: 二次代价下最优映射唯一且为凸势梯度，是扩散潜码≈OT映射的理论根基
Polar_factorization_and_monotone_rearran.tldr_en: Quadratic-cost optimal maps are unique convex gradients, the basis for diffusion-latent-as-OT claims

Rectified_Diffusion_Straightness_Is_Not_.title: Rectified Diffusion: Straightness Is Not Your Need in Rectified Flow
Rectified_Diffusion_Straightness_Is_Not_.tldr_zh: 论证 rectification 本质是配对重训而非直线度，推广为一般扩散的一阶 ODE 目标

Riemannian_Diffusion_Mixture_Jo_Hwang.title: Riemannian Diffusion Mixture, Jo & Hwang
Riemannian_Diffusion_Mixture_Jo_Hwang.tldr_zh: 桥过程混合构造流形生成扩散，漂移为数据方向切向量加权平均，绕开热核与散度
Riemannian_Diffusion_Mixture_Jo_Hwang.tldr_en: Bridge mixture constructs manifold generative diffusion with data-direction tangent weighted drift, avoiding heat kernel and divergence

Riemannian_Flow_Matching_Policy_RFMP_Bra.title: Riemannian Flow Matching Policy (RFMP), Braun et al.
Riemannian_Flow_Matching_Policy_RFMP_Bra.tldr_zh: 把黎曼流匹配用作机器人视觉运动策略，作者报告比 Diffusion Policy 更快更平滑

Riemannian_Proximal_Sampler_Guan_Balasub.title: Riemannian Proximal Sampler, Guan, Balasubramanian & Ma

S4S_Solving_for_a_Fast_Diffusion_Model_S.title: S4S: Solving for a Fast Diffusion Model Solver

SANA_Efficient_High_Resolution_Text_to_I.title: SANA: Efficient High-Resolution Text-to-Image Synthesis with Linear Diffusion Transformers
SANA_Efficient_High_Resolution_Text_to_I.tldr_zh: 0.6B 线性 DiT 配 32× AE 与小 LLM 编码器，笔记本 GPU 上 1024² 生成 <1s
SANA_Efficient_High_Resolution_Text_to_I.tldr_en: 0.6B linear DiT with 32x AE and small LLM encoder generates 1024² images in <1s on laptop GPU

SCOT_Semantic_Correspondence_as_an_Optim.title: SCOT: Semantic Correspondence as an Optimal Transport Problem
SCOT_Semantic_Correspondence_as_an_Optim.tldr_zh: 首次把语义对应写成 OT 问题，用显著性做边际、Sinkhorn 求全局 plan，抑制 many-to-one 错配

Scalable_Wasserstein_Gradient_Flow_via_U.title: Scalable Wasserstein Gradient Flow via Unbalanced OT
Scalable_Wasserstein_Gradient_Flow_via_U.tldr_zh: JKO 步等价于 UOT 问题，半对偶化将 WGF 生成训练复杂度从 O(K²) 降到 O(K)。

Scaling_Inference_Time_Compute_for_Diffu.title: Scaling Inference Time Compute for Diffusion Models (Inference-Time Scaling beyond Denoising Steps)

Scaling_Inference_Time_Compute_for_Diffu.tldr_en: Frames noise search as a verifier x search-algorithm design space (random, zero-order, search over paths), a second axis of diffusion inference-time scaling.

Schr_dinger_Bridge_Flow_IMF_DSBM_De_Bort.title: Schrödinger Bridge Flow for Unpaired Data Translation (α-DSBM)

Simplifying_Stabilizing_and_Scaling_Cont.title: Simplifying, Stabilizing and Scaling Continuous-time CMs (sCM)

Simulation_free_Score_Flow_Matching_SF_M.title: Simulation-free Score & Flow Matching ([SF]²M), Tong et al.

UniDB_UniDB.title: UniDB++（UniDB 期刊版）

Wasserstein_Aware_Transfer_Class_Level_A.title: Wasserstein-Aware Transfer: Class-Level Alignment for Robust Diffusion Model Adaptation
